[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5c0996b0a6dfd7a5d8d8b4f51d0785a916fac755.jpg"][/img][b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, September 2nd.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]<Update Summary>[/b] [/p][p]1. New Events[/p][p]2. New System: <Force Map>[/p][p]3. New Rules Added to the Valley of Life and Death [/p][p][/p][p][b]<September 2nd - Patch Note Details>[/b]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]■ New Events[/b][/p][p]1. Starlight Memories 14-Day Check-in event[/p][p]2. Black Dragon's Gift Box[/p][p]3. Osher's Miraculous Fortune[/p][p]4. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event[/p][p][/p][p]※ Please refer to [url="https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2196"]<Starlight Memories Event Round-up>[/url] for further details.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Update Details[/b][/p][p][b]1. New System: <Force Map>[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ccd42b23b8c4520362594b45d9248ead5059c940.png"][/img]- The Force Map is a system that allows you to view the ruling power structure across the entire Mir continent at a glance.[/p][p]- Through the Force Map, you can check the occupation status of Sabuk Castle and Bicheon Castle for all regions and servers, as well as the bidding information for Bicheon Castle Siege.[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ For more details, please refer to [/b][url="https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2204"]\[Game Encyclopedia – Force Map][/url][b].[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. New Rules Added to the Valley of Life and Death.[/b][/p][p]- Improvements have been made so that character information is not revealed inside Valley of Life and Death.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Category[/p][/th][th][p]Rule[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Character Name[/p][/td][td][p]Character names will be displayed as random names inside Valley of Life and Death.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Appearance[/p][/td][td][p]Equipped outfits will not be displayed, and characters will appear in their basic class appearance.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Spirit[/p][/td][td][p]Equipped Leader Spirits will not be displayed.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Chat[/p][/td][td][p]Only Party Chat will be available in Valley of Life and Death, and profile images in the chat window will be displayed as default images.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]3. Legendary Spirit Special Summon[/b][/p][p]- The Special Summon for the Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Fairy Dragon Goldflower’ will be available.[/p][p]- Event Period: After the update on September 2nd,2025 ~  [b]Before the update on September 30th, 2025[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where characters were abnormally displayed in certain cutscenes of the main quests.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where Mana consumption increased when using the skill “Tiger Fist” of the Warrior class during Story Mode progression.[/p][p]3. \[Appearance] Fixed an issue where certain textures were displayed abnormally during character customization.[/p][p]4. \[Appearance] Fixed an issue where hair color changed when equipping the Fourth Anniversary Celebration Headpiece.[/p][p]5. Updated acquisition routes for Mythic grade equipment.[/p][p]6. \[Ranking] Improved so that when checking rankings of other classes, your own information will not be displayed.[/p][p]- When checking other classes’ rankings, the message \[This is the ranking list of another class.] will be displayed.[/p][p]7. Corrected certain typos in the game.[/p]

tags.feature: - The Force Map is a system that allows you to view the ruling power structure across the entire Mir continent at a glance.
- Through the Force Map, you can check the occupation status of Sabuk Castle and Bicheon Castle for all regions and servers, as well as the bidding information for Bicheon Castle Siege.
- Improvements have been made so that character information is not revealed inside Valley of Life and Death.
- The Special Summon for the Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Fairy Dragon Goldflower’ will be available.

tags.bug: 1. Fixed an issue where characters were abnormally displayed in certain cutscenes of the main quests.
2. Fixed an issue where Mana consumption increased when using the skill “Tiger Fist” of the Warrior class during Story Mode progression.
3. [Appearance] Fixed an issue where certain textures were displayed abnormally during character customization.
4. [Appearance] Fixed an issue where hair color changed when equipping the Fourth Anniversary Celebration Headpiece.
7. Corrected certain typos in the game.

New Class: ‘Lionheart’[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/a22ba4a1ff6b2021c1f2b4a3019cde90b65e1878.png"][/img]1) MIR4's 7th new class, ‘Lionheart’ will be added.[/p][p]- The Lionheart is a master of versatile melee combat who not only disrupts enemy formations and dominates the battlefield through powerful charges, but can also heal allies and inflict debuffs on enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]2) Exclusive equipment, skills, and outfits for the Lionheart will be added.[/p][p][b]\[Lionheart Skill Introduction][/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="137,121,"][tr][th colwidth="137"][p]Image[/p][/th][th colwidth="121"][p]Skill Name[/p][/th][th][p]Skill Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/0f5729411679d1c5621b2f74480ef145491ea5e9.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Gale Kick[/p][/td][td][p]The form of swiftly approaching and overpowering enemies like a gale to confuse them, making them unable to react.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5d3d32241a901c981309659328a1afb6e97db9d3.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Tiger Fist[/p][/td][td][p]The martial art of instantly overwhelming enemies with incredible power like a fearless tiger roaring.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/c1c03657294894daf46b0141e7ad25e7bd44f70a.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Assault Strike[/p][/td][td][p]This technique vibrates the space itself to unleash explosive Inner Force like raging thunder and sandstorm, violently shaking the surroundings and stunning enemies.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/8b9d57e37588209669993bcede188d69e44540ef.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Terrorizing Crash[/p][/td][td][p]Compressing one's Inner Force to the extreme, this destructive technique instills extreme fear in surrounding enemies with unbearable killing intent and nullifies their energy.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/768bfe7f784e6f4accfdcc1490314d75efc57f5f.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Powerful Quake[/p][/td][td][p]By imbuing the ground with mighty Inner Force, a Lionheart can generate a deep shaking underground and explode multiple shockwaves to trip nearby enemies.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/b52a2c8d6a2ef8bcfb29bab50a089540dcecee3e.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Neutralizing Strike[/p][/td][td][p]This advanced oppression technique precisely injects Lionheart's inner energy into the enemy's energy path, inflicting critical damage and neutralizing the target.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/07903da9abafffd53e408473eea668f6e938b153.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Hardened Bulwark[/p][/td][td][p]Using the power of the depth of one's body to emit Inner Force, this secret defensive technique of Lionheart envelops the entire body with a barrier of Inner Force, reflecting enemy attacks and minimizing impact.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/90abb9e6ba829a9116b3327c7d8f721f567ac03a.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Encircling Capture[/p][/td][td][p]Energy emitted from the fingertips forms a barrier in front, and the enemies that are sucked in are bound by chains of energy woven with fighting spirit, instantly pulled to the center.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/4e5782705c4b0de737da61a3ebe266331b7bdcab.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Flurry of Strikes[/p][/td][td][p]Raising the body's power to its extreme and spinning the entire body like a whirlwind, this technique fiercely drives one forward as if imbued with the energy of a ferocious tiger.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/d2a421c97b86d66c6d9a6cfe44f4782317f64af3.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Healing Technique[/p][/td][td][p]This skill restores one's Inner Force by utilizing Lionheart's powerful ability to control energy flow, allowing wounds to quickly heal and continue fighting.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2cc7af432fc5d253eae15949ec9ed5c530b080a7.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Flash Assault[/p][/td][td][p]Lionheart's well-known charging form, rushing to enemies in a flash and striking them from behind to knock them with mighty force.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/97a8dd2004e35f73bdd8c52c86529f86a2c30c0c.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Meteor Smash[/p][/td][td][p]The deadly attack technique of harnessing the energy of heaven and earth to annihilate the surroundings with intense shockwaves, like a meteor falling from the sky.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="137"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/9ac879ecf79413cf78d9a16ec68b0d8c72801eb8.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="121"][p]Rampaging Lightning (Ultimate)[/p][/td][td][p]The ultimate form of surrounding the enemies with lightning-like electric chains emitted from one's hands, continuously bombarding them to disrupt their formation and shatter morale.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]- The new class ‘Lionheart’ will be restricted from using or purchasing certain appearance equipment.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Appearance Equipment Unavailable for Lionheart (Usage and Purchase Restricted)][/b][/p][p]- Headpiece Exchange Ticket I, II, III, IV[/p][p]- Outfit Exchange Ticket I, II, III, IV[/p][p]- Cool Summer Toy Exchange Ticket[/p][p]- Outerworldly Outfit and Headpiece Exchange Ticket[/p][p]- Creepy Night Festival Weapon, Headpiece and Outfit Exchange Ticket[/p][p]- Mercenary Outfit, Beret Headpiece and Bulletproof Helmet Headpiece Exchange Ticket[/p][p]- Splendid Snow Flurry Festival Outfit and Headpiece Exchange Ticket[/p][p]- Wayfarer Rangers Rider Weapon, Outfit and Helmet Exchange Ticket[/p][p]- Fresh Farm Product Weapon Exchange Ticket[/p][p][/p][p]3) The new class ‘Lionheart’ cannot perform Class Change.[/p][p]- All Class Changes between Lionheart → other classes, or other classes → Lionheart are not possible. [/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Server Merge[/b][/p][p][b]1. Server Merge will be carried out.[/b][/p][p]- To support necessary transfers after the Server Merge, you can purchase the ‘4th Anniversary Celebration: National Pass’ item for 400 Copper until the update on September 2nd.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p]Product Name[/p][/th][th][p]Price[/p][/th][th][p]Purchase Conditions[/p][/th][th][p]Purchase Limit (per character)[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]4th Anniversary Celebration: National Pass[/p][/td][td][p]400 Copper[/p][/td][td][p]Level 40 or higher[/p][/td][td][p]1[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b]※ The ‘4th Anniversary Celebration: National Pass’ cannot be purchased in the Boosting World server.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- To ensure a smooth Server Merge, the restricted ‘Heist’ content will be available again after the maintenance on August 19th, and the ‘Clan Match’ content will be available starting from the maintenance on September 2nd.[/p][p] - Since two servers will be merged into a single new server, there will inevitably be certain data that cannot be transferred or will be reset. Please check the<Server Merge Detailed Announcement> for more information.[/p][p][b]※ The Server Merge will take place during the maintenance, and after the maintenance, please check the Server Merge list and log in to the corresponding server.[/b][/p][p][b]※ For detailed information about the Server Merge list, data that cannot be transferred, and reset data, please refer to the [/b][url="https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2139"]<Server Merge Detailed Announcement>[/url][b].[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Boosting World[/b][/p][p][b]1. A growth-specialized server <Boosting World> will be added.[/b][/p][p]- Starting from August 19th, 2025, 17:00 (UTC+8), the Boosting World server will be open for approximately 4 months, offering various benefits to help characters grow rapidly.[/p][p]- In the Boosting World server, interference from other servers through world-level content will be blocked, allowing players to focus solely on growth.[/p][p]- Server Operation Period : August 19th, 2025, 17:00 (UTC+8) ~ [b]Before the maintenance on December 9th, 2025[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Boosting World server characters will receive exclusive benefits.[/b][/p][p]- Boosting World exclusive Growth Buff[/p][p]- Boosting World exclusive Popup Products[/p][p]- Boosting World exclusive Growth Support Pass[/p][p]- Boosting World exclusive Events[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. When the Boosting World server operation period ends, it will be converted into a regular server.[/b][/p][p]- During the benefit period of the Boosting World server, you can continue your adventures with the Clan and comrades you’ve bonded with. After it is converted into a regular server, you will be able to enjoy various game content that was previously unavailable in the Boosting World server.[/p][p][b]※ For more details, please refer to [/b][url="https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1828"]<Game Encyclopedia – Boosting World>[/url][b].[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Update Details[/b][/p][p][b]1. A new mount <Lifeguard Jet Ski> will be added.[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/aee541a631d64aa144996a6799febf1dd9771ce9.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][th][p]Lifeguard Jet Ski[/p][/th][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]2. The <Scripture Hall Skill Tome> Summon event will end.[/b][/p][p]1) The Divine Dragon's Promise Points obtained from the Scripture Hall Skill Tome Summon will be removed upon event conclusion without being transferred.[/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][p]1. \[Equipment] Fixed an issue where the recommended weapon equipment (!) indicator would not appear even when owning a weapon with higher Power Score. [/p][p]2. \[Equipment] Fixed an issue where the recommended equipment (!) indicator appeared on Magical Soul Orb and Special Magical Soul Orb.[/p][p]- The recommended (!) indicator is not intended to be displayed for Magical Soul Orb and Special Magical Soul Orb.  [/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where the ‘Void Bull Specter’ in the \[World 1] Demon Bull Temple 3F would not drop a reward box if it died outside of its designated area. [/p][p]4. Fixed an issue where the skill effects of the Diviner Octy were displayed abnormally in iOS environments. [/p][p]5. Fixed an issue where the movement animation of the NPC ‘Hangga’ during the main quest was displayed abnormally. [/p][p]6. Fixed an issue where an equipped Ancient Treasure would be unequipped upon Ancient Treasure promotion. [/p][p]7. Improved so that a warning pop-up will appear when a potential downgrade in enhancement level may occur upon enhancement failure. [/p][p]8. Improved so that when using a box item containing multiple items, the acquired items will be displayed in order of grade[/p][p]- If both currencies and items are included, they will be displayed in the order of currency → items by grade. [/p][p]9. Fixed an issue where an equipped Conquest Treasure would occasionally be locked in the first slot of the equipment window. [/p][p]10. Fixed an issue where obtaining a Conquest Treasure would occasionally display the recommended equipment (!) indicator instead of the newly acquired (NEW) indicator. [/p][p]11. Corrected various in-game typos.[/p]

[b]1. New Transference Equipment: <Sondeok's Shoulder Pad>[/b][/p][p]1) The newly added Transference Equipment, Sondeok's Shoulder Pad, provides PHYS DEF and Spell DEF as its base stats. As it is enhanced, additional attributes and a passive skill can be unlocked.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Enhancement Stage[/p][/th][th][p]Effect Gained[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]3[/p][/td][td][p]Silence RES Boost[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]6[/p][/td][td][p]PvP DMG Reduction[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8[/p][/td][td][p]Sondeok's Ambition: When hit, there is a 10% chance to grant a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to 30% of Max HP for 20 sec (cooldown 120 sec).[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]9[/p][/td][td][p]Knockdown RES Boost[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]12[/p][/td][td][p]CRIT EVA[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]2) Eight new repeatable achievements related to Sondeok's Shoulder Pad have been added.[/p][p]- Each failed enhancement attempt at specific stages will accumulate toward these achievements, and you can earn an enhanced Sondeok's Shoulder Pad as a reward upon completion.[/p][p][/p][p]3) ‘Sondeok's Shoulder Pad’ Crafting Recipe[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][th][p]Crafting NPC[/p][/th][th][p]Crafted Item[/p][/th][th][p]Required Materials[/p][/th][th][p]Great Success Chance[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td rowspan="2"][p]Arcadia Spirit Village[/p][p]<Craft Treasure>[/p][p]Shaoshao[/p][/td][td rowspan="2"][p]Sondeok's Shoulder Pad x1[/p][/td][td][p]Spacetime Powder x2[/p][/td][td rowspan="2"][p]5%[/p][p](Great Success Grants Sondeok TE Box x5)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Darksteel x10,000[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]※ Please refer to [url="https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1524"]\[Game Encyclopedia - Transference Equipment][/url] for further details.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. However, when you are the Party Leader, the skill effect is also applied to party members within a certain range.[/p][p]- Witch Arcana can be obtained through the Invoke feature from <Mythic Spirit> Diviner Octy, located in Arcadia Spirit Village.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="194,"][tr][th colwidth="194"][p]Skill Name[/p][/th][th][p]Skill Effect[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="194"][p]Strengthening Potion[/p][/td][td][p]Increases Max HP by 3700, Max MP by 2050, PHYS DEF by 100, and Spell DEF by 300.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="194"][p]Sharpening Potion[/p][/td][td][p]Increases Basic ATK DMG by 50% and Bash ATK DMG by 50%, and reduces CRIT DMG Taken by 50% and Bash DMG Taken by 50%.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="194"][p]Forest's Heart[/p][/td][td][p]Increases Silence Success Chance by 50%, CRIT by 200, and Hunting EXP Gain by 40%.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="194"][p]Squishy[/p][/td][td][p]Upon attacking, there is a 10% chance to reduce the enemy's PHYS DEF by 607 and Spell DEF by 607 for 15 sec (cooldown 40 sec).[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="194"][p]Languid Temptation[/p][/td][td][p]Upon a CRIT attack, there is a 15% chance to reduce nearby enemies' Accuracy by 675 and EVA by 675 for 20 sec (cooldown 60 sec).[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="194"][p]\[Party Leader] Red Blessing[/p][/td][td][p]Upon attacking, there is a 10% chance to increase the party's CRIT by 45 and CRIT ATK DMG by 45% for 15 sec (cooldown 60 sec).[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]3. New Appearance Equipment: <Courageous Lifeguard>[/b][/p][p]- The ‘Courageous Lifeguard Outfit’ and ‘Courageous Lifeguard Headpiece’ have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/3a8dead5937f3a129141c22ce7f0ede2ed717195.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/1dafe1ce32928b52390535f93989f8ac9f520b18.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colspan="2"][p]Courageous Lifeguard Outfit, Headpiece[/p][/th][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]- Two new ‘Courageous Lifeguard’ back ornaments have been added.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/c04dd55133ecfeb1ff84bad694c5a51a324ddad4.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/cd7aaecdda8b5667594b189e651819ab515bb742.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colspan="2"][p]Courageous Lifeguard Buoy (Left)[/p][p]Courageous Lifeguard Oxygen Tank (Right)[/p][/th][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][p]1. \[Spirit] Fixed an issue where the summoned position of Forest Fairy Lara was displayed abnormally.[/p][p]2. \[Spirit] Fixed an issue where the ‘\[Party Leader] Death Dragon's Pledge’ skill did not apply certain effects when not in a party.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where the increased Knockdown Success Chance and Silence Success Chance effects from the \[Party Leader] Death Dragon's Pledge skill were not applied.[/p][p]3. \[Raid] Fixed an issue where Clan Coins were displayed as a reward after completing a Raid with a character not in a Clan.[/p][p]4. \[Raid] Fixed an issue where characters not in a Clan could receive Clan Coins as rewards upon completing a Hell Raid.[/p][p]5. \[Party] Fixed an issue where party members could not join through chat after using the 'Invite' function via Clan Chat when a Clan Party was created.[/p][p]6. Fixed an issue where the queue cancel prompt did not appear when entering a different Valley or Labyrinth after registering for a queue in Valley or Labyrinth.[/p][p]7. Added queue functionality in certain areas to improve gameplay stability.[/p][p]- Affected areas: All fields inside Mirage Ship, Sanctuary of Hydra, Hydra's Depths[/p][p]8. Adjusted spawn location when restarting in certain areas for smoother gameplay.[/p][p]- Characters will now respawn in Snake Pit Village when reconnecting in Sanctuary of Hydra and Hydra’s Depths (1F to 5F).[/p][p]9. Increased the chance to obtain Blue Septaria when Transference Equipment is destroyed during enhancement.[/p][p]10. Increased the drop rate of Uncommon Burnt Skill Tome from regular monsters in Redmoon Purgatory 1-7F.[/p][p]11. Improved pathing in certain areas of Ginkgo Valley.[/p][p]- Removed areas where movement was only possible while sticking to walls.[/p][p]12. Fixed an issue where players could go outside the field area from a specific location in Mirage Ship \[World 6] Bicheon Labyrinth.[/p][p]13. Fixed various in-game typos.[/p]

[/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New Content: <Scripture Hall>
1) The Scripture Hall is a special archive that preserves the Peerless Skills of the Mir Continent.
- You can restore the forms of skills archived in the Scripture Hall to gain additional stat bonuses and special rewards.
- It unlocks when your character reaches Level 120 and requires Arcane Tomes, which can be obtained through existing Skill Tomes or the Restoration Center within the Scripture Hall.

2) The Scripture Hall consists of the 1st Scripture Hall, 2nd Scripture Hall, and the Restoration Center.
- 1st & 2nd Scripture Hall: Allows you to register Skill Tomes and Arcane Tomes to complete the forms of the archived skills.
- Restoration Center: Allows you to restore Skill Arcane Tomes and Ancient Arcane Tomes using Burnt Skill Tomes as materials.

1) Redmoon Purgatory is a new region that serves as the primary source of Burnt Skill Tomes, Skill / Ancient Arcane Tomes used in the Scripture Hall, as well as powerful equipment items.
- Redmoon Purgatory is located within the Spiritual Center Area and consists of a 7-floor labyrinth. 
- Within Redmoon Purgatory, you can encounter various boss monsters that drop powerful equipment, Burnt Skill Tomes, Ancient / Skill Arcane Tomes, and Ancient Boxes that require Ancient Keys to open.

2) Redmoon Purgatory Floor Entry Level Requirements
- Redmoon Purgatory is accessible to characters Level 120 and above, with each floor having its own level requirement.

- Redmoon Purgatory contains Quest Boss Monsters, Summon Boss Monsters, and Special Boss Monsters.
- Quest Boss Monsters: Appear on each floor daily at a set time. If not defeated within a certain duration, they disappear.
- Summon Boss Monsters: Can be summoned using summoning badges in the Hidden Sector and Forbidden Sector of floors 1F through 6F. Defeating these bosses counts toward Monthly Repeatable Missions.
- Special Boss Monster: On 7F, the special boss <Hellish Lord> Helbar appears every Wednesday at 23:00 (UTC+8). Upon defeat, there is a low chance to obtain an Ancient Box that can be opened with an Ancient Key.

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, May 27th.

[b]Update Summary[/b]

◈Game Updates◈
1. New Events
2. First Season of Season Token <EXDRA> Ends
3. New Transference Equipment: <Chogye's Pakua>
4. New Appearance Equipment: <Galactic Rangers>

◈XDRACO Updates◈
1. WEMIX PAY System Introduction
- The in-game Shop now supports direct purchases with WEMIX, replacing the previous pWEMIX$ system.

[b][May 27th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ New Events[/b]
1. Cool 14-Day Check-in
2. Osher's Miraculous Fortune
3. Ancient Coin/Clan Coin Exchange Shop

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2056][Notice - Dragon's Cool Repaying Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. End of EXDRA Season 1
1) The first season of the seasonal token EXDRA, which ran for 24 weeks, will conclude with the update on May 27th. After a 2-week break, Season 2 will begin on June 10.
- In EXDRA Season 2, players can look forward to new Ancient Treasures and Special Magical Soul Orbs, as well as ‘Conquest Treasure’ that can be equipped to Conquest buildings.
- Detailed information about Season 2 will be provided in the June 10th Patch Notes, so stay tuned!

2) With the end of EXDRA Season 1, EXDRA1 token minting will no longer be available.
- EXDRA1 tokens already held can continue to be traded freely on PNIX DEX.
- Even after the season ends, you can still exchange their EXDRA1 tokens in the in-game Season Token Exchange Station for Ancient Equipment Boxes and Special Magical Soul Orb Boxes.

3) Materials for minting EXDRA1 tokens will no longer be obtainable.
- The minting materials for EXDRA1 tokens, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’, will only be available until the June 10th Update. After that, they will no longer drop.
- The sources of ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’ will be gradually phased out as follows:

[b][Red Nebula Powder][/b]
- Mission Scrolls and Monthly Check-in Rewards: From June 2025, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will be replaced with ‘Blue Septaria’, which is used for EXDRA Season 2 token minting.
- Limited-Time Products: Products containing ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will no longer be sold.
- Transference Equipment Enhancement Fail Rewards: Until the June 10th Update, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will be rewarded. However, after the update, it will be replaced with ‘Blue Septaria’.

[b][Red Septaria][/b]
- Power Score Rankings (All Servers): Ranking rewards will not be distributed until the June 10th Update due to the end of EXDRA1 minting.
- Disenchant Rewards: Until the June 10th Update, Red Septaria will be rewarded. However, after the update, it will be replaced with Blue Septaria.

4) 11 New crafting recipes have been added using ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’.
- Crafting is available through <Flame Bead Craftsman> Poipoi in Sanctuary of Hydra.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. WEMIX$ Payment System Updated to WEMIX PAY
1) The previous WEMIX$ payment system using pWEMIX$ for in-app purchases has been replaced with the WEMIX PAY system that uses WEMIX directly.
- You can now purchase items using WEMIX without exchanging to pWEMIX$.

[b]What is WEMIX PAY?[/b]
- WEMIX PAY is a new payment method in WEMIX PLAY designed to lower onboarding platform fees for games while also offering in-game benefits for players. A portion of revenue from WEMIX PAY is used to support preserving the value of WEMIX, contributing to the sustainable growth of the WEMIX ecosystem.
- WEMIX PAY uses WEMIX Coin as its payment currency.

※ The previously supported ‘Cart’ feature in WEMIX$ payment system will be added to the WEMIX PAY service in a future update.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/757][Game Encyclopedia - WEMIX PAY][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. [Bicheon Castle Siege] Improved Castle Siege so that the Castle Gate’s HP decreases more when the ‘Gate Controller’ object is destroyed.
2. [Spirit] Improved the ‘Infinite Breaths’ skill for Bloodtip Drago Spirit and Drago Magical Soul Orb so that it activates regardless of whether the Ultimate attack hits.
3. [Spirit] Vagabond Cloud Sage’s ‘Distortion Spell’ activation condition has been changed.
- Before: Activated when using the skill
- After: Activated when attacking
4. [Spirits] Fixed a display issue where stat gains from unlocking Divine Dragon Descent were shown on the Transcend Spirit result screen.
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

notes.title: Patch Note - May 13th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5c0996b0a6dfd7a5d8d8b4f51d0785a916fac755.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, May 13th.

[b]Update Summary[/b]

◈Game Updates◈
1. New Events
2. New Legendary Wind Party Leader Spirit: <Vagabond Cloud Sage>

◈XDRACO Updates◈
1. MIR4 NFTs to Transition from Tornado Chain to WEMIX3.0 Mainnet

[b][May 13th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]◈ Game Update ◈[/b]

[b]■ New Events[/b]
1. Ringring's 28-Day Check-in
2. Black Dragon's Gift Box
3. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2045][Notice - Dragon's Warm Repaying Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New Legendary Wind Party Leader Spirit: <Vagabond Cloud Sage>
- Own Effect: Spell ATK 40
- Vagabond Cloud Sage’s Party Leader skill, '[Party Leader] Distortion Spell', only activates and applies to yourself when you are not the Party Leader. However, when you are the Party Leader, the skill effect is also applied to party members within a certain range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/53e48acc1fed3a6161ac1ea99fde5dcb6c904e5c.png[/img]
[table]
[tr]
[th]Skill Name[/th]
[th]Skill Effect[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Mana Cloud[/td]
[td]Increases Max MP by 1400, Spell ATK by 100, Spell DEF by 100, and EVA by 80.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Mist of Silence[/td]
[td]Increases Skill ATK DMG by 15%, Silence Success Chance by 25%, and Silence RES Chance by 25%, and reduces Skill DMG Taken by 15%.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Vagabond's Path[/td]
[td]Increases Antidemon Power by 10% and Energy Gain by 10%, and reduces Skill MP Cost by 10%.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Mana Storm[/td]
[td]Upon attacking, there is a 3% chance to increase Skill ATK DMG by 30% for 15 sec (cooldown 48 sec).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][Party Leader] Distortion Spell[/td]
[td]Upon using a skill, reduces the party's Skill DMG Taken by 30% and Skill MP Cost by 5% for 15 sec (cooldown 60 sec).[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
2. Vagabond Cloud Sage Special Summon
- Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Vagabond Cloud Sage’ Special Summon has begun!
- Special Summon Period: After the update on May 13th, 2025 ~ Before the update on June 10th, 2025

3. Added Legendary Spirits that can be obtained through the following: Combine, Exchange, Mystic Incense Burner, Legendary Spirit Stone Restoration Box, Legendary Divine Dragon's Spirit Mystery Box, and Legendary Spirit Stone Summon Box
- Legendary Spirits Added: Mystic Meow Haeryeong, Lookout Luna, Celestial Guardian Eldra

[b]◈ XDRACO Updates ◈[/b]

[b]■ NFT Mainnet Transition[/b]
1. MIR4 NFTs to Transition from Tornado Chain to WEMIX3.0 Mainnet
- The environment for minting, storing (in-game use), and trading MIR4 NFTs will transition to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet.
- All previously minted NFTs before this update must be transitioned to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet.
- Even if your NFT was previously transitioned from Tornado to WEMIX3.0 after the November 2024 NFT Marketplace update, it must be transitioned again in accordance with this mainnet transition.
- Transition Effective Date: May 13th, 2025, 10:00 (UTC+8)
※ Mainnet Conversion work may be delayed depending on the maintenance progress.

[NFT Transition Guide]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2cf60081a645c57022515ec7c81718723f2fb7dd.png[/img]
- Tansition Target: All NFTs that are minted (Tornado and trading Mainnet NFTs)
- Transition Method:
  1) Connect to WEMIX PLAY.
  2) Log in to WEMIX PLAY.
  3) Check NFTs through: My Wallet > NFTs > Owned NFT
  4) Select the NFT you want to transition.
  5) Click "NFT Transition".

※ NFTs minted after this update will not require a separate transition.
※ No gas fees will be charged during the transition process.

2. MIR4 NFT Marketplace Guidelines
- NFTs minted after this update can be transferred between wallets once sealed.
- NFTs that remain unsold on the Marketplace must be canceled from sale and transitioned to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet before relisting.
- NFTs that are not transitioned after the update can no longer be newly listed for sale.
- On the old Tornado Chain-based Marketplace, only sale cancellations and NFT retrievals will be possible going forward.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2025][Pre-Notice: 2025, MIR4 NFT Transition][/url] for further details.

[b]■ MIRAGE[/b]

Changes to MIRAGE Usage Following NFT Transition to WEMIX3.0 Mainnet
- Mirage Chain Conversion Implementation Schedule: May 14th, 10:00 (UTC+8)
- Before the implementation of the Mirage Chain Conversion, only Tornado Chain NFTs can be used in the MIRAGE content.
- To register an NFT to your MIRAGE Roster, it must first be converted to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet, just like in-game NFTs.
- If you currently have NFTs registered to ‘My Roster’ that were minted on the Tornado Chain, you can continue using them for activities such as entering Hidden Valley Capture, MiraX enhancement, and recharging Vigor without converting them to the new mainnet.
- However, if you seal a Tornado Chain NFT that is already registered in ‘My Roster’, you must convert it to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet in order to register it again to your roster.

※ If any errors occur due to continued use of Tornado Chain NFTs after the update, please follow the provided instructions to convert them to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet before proceeding.

[b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. [Missions] Improved target quantity for gathering-related missions.
 - The required quantities for gathering-related missions (Plant, Ore, Energy, Darksteel, Box, and Void Orb) have been reduced, allowing for quicker mission completion.
2. [Craft] Fixed an issue where Dragon Materials would incorrectly display as 0, even when Dragon Materials were available, during equipment crafting.
3. Fixed an issue where the name and description of the buff granted by the Healing Tonic item were displayed incorrectly.
4. Fixed an issue where the effects of Mythic items among the obtainable items in the Black Dragon's Battlefield were not displayed.
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5c0996b0a6dfd7a5d8d8b4f51d0785a916fac755.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, April 29th.

[b]◈Update Summary◈[/b]
1. New Events
2. New Mythic Equipment
3. New Mythic Spirits
4. Item Drop List Improvements for Various Content
5. Bicheon Castle Siege Object Balance Improvements

[b][April 29th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ New Events[/b]
1. Golden 14-Day Check-in
2. Divine Dragon's Blessing
3. Dreamfly's Golden Petals Exchange Shop

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2034][Notice - Dreamfly's Golden Petal Festival Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New Mythic Equipment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/40481242d4fbd8c7092385a9a2a941a1bc5a1562.png[/img]
1) Mythic Equipment is the highest-grade gear, offering far superior stats compared to all existing equipment and capable of unleashing powerful unique effects exclusive to Mythic Equipment.
- Mythic Equipment can be enhanced up to Stage 20.
- Mythic Equipment is not destroyed upon enhancement failure, but the enhancement stage may decrease.
- Each Mythic Equipment possesses a powerful unique effect, which can be changed using the Manifest Ability feature.

2) New <Mythic Dragon Material> Martial World Master NPC
- <Mythic Dragon Material> Martial World Master can be found in the Spiritual Center.
- Using the Awaken function from <Mythic Dragon Material> Martial World Master, you can awaken Legendary Equipment into Mythic Equipment.
* Equipment Awakening consumes Tier 4 Legendary Equipment that has been enhanced to Stage 15, Divine Dragon's Soul, Mythic Equipment Materials (Eternal Steel/Coldsteel/Jade), and Dragonsteel as materials.

- The Invoke function of <Mythic Dragon Material> Martial World Master allows you to craft the Divine Dragon’s Soul.
* Invoke lets you combine 3 Legendary Dragon Materials to attempt crafting a Divine Dragon’s Soul. Upon failure, you will receive Divine Dragon’s Promise Points. You can obtain a Divine Dragon’s Soul either by succeeding in Invoke or by collecting 5 Divine Dragon’s Promise Points.

3) New Mythic Equipment Crafting Recipes
- Crafting recipes for Chaotic Enhancement Stone (used for enhancing Mythic Equipment) and Stone of Manifest Ability (used to change Mythic Equipment’s unique effect) have been added.
[table]
[tr]
[th]Crafting NPC[/th]
[th]Crafting Item[/th]
[th]Crafting Materials[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Each Area’s Major Village <Craftsman> NPC[/td]
[td]Chaotic Enhancement Stone x1[/td]
[td]- Legendary Mystic Enhancement Stone x5
- Legendary Darkened Enhancement Stone x5
- Radiant Spacetime Powder x1
- Legendary Divine Dragon’s Enhancement Stone x1
- Dragonsteel x100[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Each Area’s Major Village <Craftsman> NPC[/td]
[td]Stone of Manifest Ability x1[/td]
[td]- Divine Dragon's Fragment x300
- Radiant Spacetime Powder x1
- Darksteel x20,000[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
- ‘Divine Dragon’s Fragment’ can be obtained through Disenchanting, opening Epic/Legendary/Mythic Ancient Boxes, participating in Clan Expedition, Hell Raid, and from Floor 11 of Fissured Magic Square/Secret Peak.
* When crafting 'Chaotic Enhancement Stone' and 'Stone of Manifest Ability', Great Success will not occur, and all crafted items will be non-tradable.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2028][Game Encyclopedia - Mythic Equipment][/url] for further details.

2. New Mythic Spirits
1) Mythic Spirits are the highest-grade spirits, possessing overwhelming stats and skills.
- A Mythic Spirit has 6 skills and can be equipped with up to 8 Spirit Treasures.
- Mythic Spirits can be transcended up to Stage 4.

2) New <Mythic Spirit> Diviner Octy NPC
- <Mythic Spirit> Diviner Octy can be found in the Arcadia Spirit Village.
- Through the Invoke function of <Mythic Spirit> Diviner Octy, you can obtain a Mythic Spirit Stone.
* Invoke is a feature that allows you to combine 3 Legendary Spirit Stones to attempt crafting a Mythic Spirit Stone. If the Invoke fails, you will receive 1 random Legendary Spirit Stone that does not possess a Party Leader Skill, along with a Divine Dragon's Promise Point. Upon a successful Invoke or by accumulating 15 Divine Dragon’s Promise Points, you will obtain 1 random Mythic Spirit Stone.

3) New Mythic Earth Spirit: 'Demon Dragon Roxion'
- Own Effect: PHYS DEF 40, Spell DEF 40
- Demon Dragon Roxion’s Party Leader skill, '[Party Leader] Aspect of the Earth', only activates and applies to yourself when you are not the Party Leader. However, when you are the Party Leader, the skill effect is also applied to party members within a certain range.

notes.title: Patch Note - April 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5c0996b0a6dfd7a5d8d8b4f51d0785a916fac755.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, April 1st.

[b]◈Update Summary◈[/b]
1. New Events
2. New Object: Ancient Box
3. New Item: Ancient Key
4. New Content: Black Dragon's Battlefield
5. Improvements to Domination Server and Tower of Black Dragon
6. Updates to the Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Crafting Item List

[b][April 1st Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ New Events[/b]
1. Return of Truthful & Lying 7-Day Check-in

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2004][Notice- Return of Truthful & Lying 7-Day Check-in][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New Object: ‘Ancient Box’
1) The Ancient Box is a special treasure chest object that can be opened using an Ancient Key.
- When opening an Ancient Box, an Ancient Key of the same grade as the box is required.
2) Ancient Box can appear in the following areas of the Domination Server.
- [Domination] Sabuk Castle
- [Domination] Sabuk Town
- [Domination Labyrinth] 1~4F
- [Black Dragon Valley] 1~4F
3) When you defeat the following Domination Server boss monsters, there is a certain probability that an Ancient Box will appear.
- [Black Dragon's Battlefield] Jarrgon of Black Night, Kargis of White Night, Tilion of Moonlit Night
- [Tower of Black Dragon] 4F ‘Diabolic Skydragon’
- [Black Dragon Valley] 4F ‘Death Dragon Soul Chaser’
- [Black Dragon Abaddon] Drakazan

2. New Item: ‘Ancient Key’
1) Three new ‘Ancient Key’ crafting recipes have been added.
- You can craft Ancient Keys through the crafting NPC <Object Collector> Mo Bulwi located in [Domination] Sabuk Castle / Tower of Black Dragon / Black Dragon's Battlefield.
[table]
[tr]
[th]Crafting Item[/th]
[th]Crafting Materials[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Epic Ancient Key x1[/td]
[td]Blood Seeker Stone x3
Blue Brilliant Jade x3
Yellow Moon Stone x3
Epic Pomegranate Flower x5
Darksteel x300,000
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Legendary Ancient Key x1[/td]
[td]Blood Seeker Stone x5
Blue Brilliant Jade x5
Yellow Moon Stone x5
Epic Pomegranate Flower x10
Darksteel x500,000
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Mythic Ancient Key x1[/td]
[td]Blood Seeker Stone x20
Blue Brilliant Jade x20
Yellow Moon Stone x20
Epic Pomegranate Flower x40
Darksteel x2,000,000
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
2) Materials needed for crafting Ancient Keys (Blood Seeker Stone/Blue Brilliant Jade/Yellow Moon Stone) can be obtained by defeating monsters in the following regions:
- [Domination] Sabuk Town
- [Tower of Black Dragon] 1~4F
- [Domination Labyrinth] 1~4F
- [Black Dragon Valley] 1~4F

3. New Content: ‘Black Dragon's Battlefield’
[table]
[tr]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/bef60ec9c99fc024a392aeceb5a00c8a7fa336be.png[/img][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Black Dragon's Battlefield[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]
1) Black Dragon's Battlefield is a new battlefield content where you can defeat boss monsters located in separate zones to obtain various rewards.
- Black Dragon's Battlefield is divided into a total of 15 zones, and you can obtain rewards through battles with boss monsters that appear in each zone.
- You can enter Black Dragon's Battlefield from character Level 95 and above, and can enter freely even after entering Floors 1-4 of Tower of Black Dragon.

2) Appearance Conditions for Boss Monsters in Black Dragon's Battlefield
[table]
[tr]
[th]Boss Name[/th]
[th]Appearance Condition[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Syrence of Black Night[/td]
[td]Appears at 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 daily.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Caelion of White Night[/td]
[td]Appears at 10:00, 16:00, 22:00 daily.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Rivark of Moonlit Night[/td]
[td]Appears once at a random time while the Domination Server is available three times a day.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Red Chaotic Spider of Polar Night[/td]
[td]Appears when summoned using the 'Red Chaotic Spider Summon Badge' in a specific area.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Black Death Skelegore of Polar Night[/td]
[td]Appears when summoned using the 'Black Death Skelegore Summon Badge' in a specific area.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
3) The boss monsters of 'Black Night/White Night/Moonlit Night' consist of a total of 4 stages.
- The boss monsters of 'Black Night/White Night/Moonlit Night' must be defeated sequentially from Stage 1 to Stage 4.
- When you defeat the monsters of the previous stage, the monsters of the next stage will appear, and the boss monsters appear in different areas for each stage.
* If you defeat the monsters of the previous stage, you must move to the area to find the monsters of the next stage.
- When you defeat the boss monsters of each stage, a treasure chest will appear, and when you defeat the boss monsters of Stage 4, an Ancient Box may appear with a certain probability.
[table]
[tr]

[tr]

[/td]
[/tr]

[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]3[/td]

Orkaz of Moonlit Night
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]4[/td]
[td]205[/td]
[td]Jarrgon of Black Night

Tilion of Moonlit Night
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
4) Two new crafting recipes for ‘Red Chaotic Spider Summon Badge’ and ‘Black Death Skelegore Summon Badge’ have been added.
- You can craft the summoning badges through the NPC <Object Collector> Mo Bulwi located in [Domination] Sabuk Castle, Tower of Black Dragon, and Black Dragon's Battlefield.
- The crafting material, ‘Black Dragon's Tear’, can be obtained with a certain probability when defeating unique monsters on the 1st to 4th floors of Tower of Black Dragon.

※ When crafting a Red Chaotic Spider/Black Death Skelegore Summon Badge, there is a 10% chance of a Great Success, and if the crafting is successful, you will obtain a tradable summoning badge.

5) New Requests for ‘Black Dragon's Battlefield’.
- Four new Requests for Black Dragon's Battlefield have been added.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1029][Game Encyclopedia - Tower of Black Dragon][/url] for further details.

4. ‘Domination Server’ and ‘Tower of Black Dragon’ Improvements
1) Increased EXP from hunting monsters in the Domination Server for the following areas:
- [Domination] Sabuk Town
- [Tower of Black Dragon] 1~4F
- [Domination Labyrinth] 1~4F

* Details will be announced in the upcoming Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Event Notice.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5c0996b0a6dfd7a5d8d8b4f51d0785a916fac755.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, February 18th.

[b]◈Update Summary◈[/b]
1. New Events
2. Boosting World Server Closure
3. Private Warehouse Expansion
4. Auto-Promote System Added

[b][February 18th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ New Events[/b]
1. Training 14-Day Check-in
2. Osher's Miraculous Fortune
3. Clan & Ancient Coin Exchange Shop
4. Divine Dragon's Surprise Mail Reward
5. Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1954][Notice - Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. Boosting World Server Closure
- The Boosting World Server, which was introduced to invigorate the MIR continent, will be closed after 12 weeks of operation.
- All Boosting World Server exclusive events and Yiun’s Boosting World Mission Scroll will end.
- Characters transferred from the Boosting World Server will now have full access to all content, just like characters on regular servers.
- Upon the closure of the Boosting World Server, all Boosting World Server characters will be transferred to a random server within their respective assigned regions. Please refer to the table below for details:
[Boosting World Server Assigned Regions]

[td]SA2[/td]

[td]NA2[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
2. Private Warehouse Expansion
1) The maximum expandable slots for the Private Warehouse have increased.
- Maximum Expandable Slots: 500 -> 999
2) Private Warehouse Expansion Tickets have been added.
- You can expand your Private Warehouse slots using Gold or the Private Warehouse Expansion Ticket.
*Even if you use the Private Warehouse Expansion Ticket items, you cannot expand your Private Warehouse beyond the maximum expandable slots.
- Private Warehouse Expansion Tickets can be purchased from the Shop.

3. New Auto-Promote System
- A new system has been added that allows Special Magical Soul Orbs and Ancient Treasures to be promoted automatically.
- You can set a Promotion Goal level, and the system will continuously attempt Promotion until the goal is reached.
* Special Magical Soul Orbs can be auto-promoted up to Lv.8, and Ancient Treasures up to Rare Tier 4.
- Promotion will continue until the Promotion Goal level is reached or the required materials run out.
- Materials used for Auto-Promote are the same as those used for regular Promotion, and all consumed materials will be destroyed regardless of the result.

4. Mystic Meow Haeryeong Special Summon
- Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Mystic Meow Haeryeong’ Special Summon has begun! 
- Special Summon Period: After the February 18th, 2025 Update ~ Before the March 18th, 2025 Update

5. New Legendary Spirits Added to the Legendary Spirit Stone Restoration Box, Legendary Divine Dragon's Spirit Mystery Box, and Combine Spirit Stones
- Newly Added Legendary Spirits: Thunder Divine Dragon Toril, Diviner Octy, Soothing Healer Haeryu
*Mystic Meow Haeryeong, Lookout Luna, and Celestial Guardian Eldra will not be obtainable from the Legendary Spirit Stone Restoration Box, Legendary Divine Dragon's Spirit Mystery Box, or Combine Spirit Stones.

[b]Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. Fixed an issue where the Taoist’s Moonlight Wave and Moonlight Orb skills hit more times than intended during Story Mode.
2. Improved the Request list to display Requests that cannot be progressed due to unmet prerequisites.
- If the prerequisite conditions are not met, the quest cannot be accepted, and a message stating "Requirements unknown." will be displayed.
3. Fixed an issue where some objects in [Elite] Underground Jail in the Sabuk Area spawned in locations that made them impossible to collect.
4. Improved certain Enhancement Stones by adding a [Use] button, allowing players to go directly to the corresponding Enhance screen.
- Affected Items: Transference Equipment Enhancement Stones, Divine Dragon's Dragon Artifact Enhancement Stone/Ancient Treasure Enhancement Stone
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

[b][January 7th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ Boosting World Server Exclusive Event[/b]
1. Yiun's 28-Day Accumulated Check-in II

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1916][Event - Yiun's 28-Day Accumulated Check-in II][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/70472bcf6f82eac039ccbfd61678259a976371fa.png[/img]1. New Growth Content: Descent of Divine Dragon
1) Descent of Divine Dragon is a new growth content feature that allows you to unlock Pressure Points using Dragon Materials and Dragonsteel, granting your character various stats.
2) There are six Pressure Points, each requiring different materials for unlocking.
- The materials to unlock the six Pressure Points are [Dragon Scale, Dragon Claw, Dragon Leather, Dragon Eye, Dragon Horn, Dragon Sphere].
- Dragon Materials can be substituted with the ‘Divine Dragon’s Key’ item, which can be acquired via Mana Dismantle or purchased from the Shop.
3) Higher-grade materials unlock higher-grade Pressure Points, with varying numbers of stats granted:
- Rare Grade: 1–3 Random Stats
- Epic Grade: 3–6 Random Stats
- Legendary Grade: 6–10 Random Stats
* Unlocking grants stats of grades C ~ B.
4) You can re-unlock Pressure Points to reassign their grade and stats.
- Re-unlocking requires the same materials as the initial unlock and cannot use lower-grade materials.
* Re-unlocking grants stats of grades C ~ B.
5) Stats assigned to Pressure Points can be readjusted using Aspiration.
- Materials required include [Aspiration’s Pledge, Dragonsteel, Copper]. Aspiration’s Pledge can be obtained via Mana Dismantle.
- The more stats assigned to a Pressure Point, the more materials are required.
- The number of stats assigned to a Pressure Point does not change during Aspiration.
* Aspiration grants stats of grades C ~ SS.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1890][Game Encyclopedia - Descent of Divine Dragon][/url] for further details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f1b87988ca3717c2eeda0e68ca4b874e41223ae1.png[/img]2. New System: Mana Dismantle
1) A new system that allows you to dismantle Rare or Epic-grade equipment or Mana Beads to obtain various growth-enhancing items.
2) Mana Dismantle has six stages for each grade: Uncommon 1–6 / Rare 1–6 / Epic 1–6. 
3) The Dismantle Stage is determined by the Grade/Tier/Enhancement Level of the materials, with higher levels yielding better rewards.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/406][Game Encyclopedia - Character][/url] for further details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2f35d38acc4d61920de36c899be74ce574b44860.png[/img]3. New System: Dragon Artifact Benediction
1) Dragon Artifact Benediction is a new system that activates additional stats for parts equipped with Black Dragon or White Dragon Artifacts.
2) Parts where Dragon Artifact Benediction is applied can be enhanced up to Level 25, with stats increasing as levels rise.
3) Stats activated by Dragon Artifact Benediction for each part are as follows:

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/998][Game Encyclopedia - Dragon Artifact][/url] for further details.

4. New Mystery: ‘Overcorrection’
1) ‘Overcorrection’ is a new Mystery consisting of six episodes:
[Overcorrection Episode Title]
- Dragon Artifact’s Ability
- Incense Burner and Heavenly Bell
- Incense Burner and White Dragon Artifact
- Cheonpa's Resurrection
- Black Dragon Artifact
- Reunion with the One Who Left
2) Completing each episode grants Mystery Codex materials and resources, with additional rewards for completing all episodes.
3) Eight new Codex achievements can be unlocked using materials from this ‘Overcorrection’ Mystery.
4) One new Mission related to ‘Overcorrection’ has been added.
5) Six new crafting recipes related to ‘Overcorrection’ have been added.

[Nine Dragon Ice Field - Guardian Soul Little Draggy]
▷ Tora Summoning Scroll x1
- Dragon’s Soul x5, Epic Mana Mystical Piece x1, Purified Soul Stone x50, Copper x700,000, Darksteel x400,000

▷Tarva Summoning Scroll x1
- White Dragon’s Soul x10, Shining Cold Jade Stone x5, Epic Magic Stone of Mana II x1, Copper x1,500,000, Darksteel x800,000

▷Barban Summoning Scroll x1
- White Dragon’s Vitae x10, Shining Steel Stone x5, Epic Magic Stone of Vigor II x1, Copper x1,500,000,  Darksteel x800,000

[Sagittarion Valley 3F - Zenith Syndicate Vestal Banjeon]
▷Karvas Summoning Scroll x1
- Black Dragon’s Soul x5, Black Dragon’s Vitae x6, Sealed Demonic Cult Tome II x1, Copper x1,500,000, Darksteel x800,000

▷Karcio Summoning Scroll x1
- White Dragon Horn x1, White Dragon Leather x1, Black Dragon Horn x1, Black Dragon Leather x1, Copper x3,000,000, Darksteel x1,500,000

- Dragon’s Vitae x5, Epic HP Mystical Piece x1, Purified Soul Stone x50, Copper x700,000, Darksteel x400,000

5. New Items
1) ‘Divine Dragon’s Key’
- Used for unlocking Pressure Points in Descent of Divine Dragon.
2) ‘Aspiration’s Pledge’
- Used for reassigning stats in Descent of Divine Dragon.
3) ‘Dragon Breath’
- Used as growth material in Dragon Artifact Benediction.
4) ‘Mana Bead’
- Used as material in Mana Dismantle or for crafting via NPCs.
5) All four new items (Divine Dragon’s Key, Aspiration’s Pledge, Dragon Breath, Mana Bead)  can be obtained through Mana Dismantle.
6) Nine new crafting recipes related to ‘Mana Beads’ have been added.

6. Codex Auto-Assign Feature Added
- When registering material items to complete a Codex, you can use the ‘Codex Auto-Assign’ feature to register multiple material items at once.
- Equipped or locked items cannot be auto-assigned.
- When multiple eligible items are available, items are registered in the following order: [Non-tradable, Tradable, XDRACO Tradable].

7. Ancient Equipment, Special Magical Soul Orbs, and Red Nebula Powder Probability Improvements and Additional Red Septaria Source Added
1) The probability of receiving Rare-grade equipment and Special Magical Soul Orbs from Ancient Equipment Boxes and Special Magical Soul Orb Boxes has been increased.
2) The probability of obtaining Red Nebula Powder upon failing to enhance Transference Equipment at +4 or higher has been increased.
3) A new method of acquiring Red Septaria has been added.
- You can receive Red Septaria at a low probability when performing Mana Dismantle from Uncommon Stage 2 ~ Epic Stage 6.

[b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. [Mission] Improved the Defeat Monster requirement for the ‘[World 2] Twinway Maze’ mission.
- Defeat Monster Requirement: 100 -> 50
2. [Mounts] Fixed an issue where the White Heart Fluffy mount’s appearance sound effect did not play properly.
3. [Codex] Fixed an issue where achievement information appeared twice in the Time Limited tab.
4. [Cosmic Harmony] Improved to auto-select the node when released from Tangled Inner Force during Training.
5. [Phantom Woods] Fixed abnormal movement locations when using Fast Travel Scrolls at Quarry.
6. [Boosting World Server] Fixed an issue where the UI would not appear when clicking on the icons for Dragonworld's Rift, Altar of Darkness, and Valley Capture.
7. Fixed an issue where the item lock indicator was displayed in other users’ information.
8. Fixed an issue where some players could not connect to the game on their designated server if they enchanted an item but did not apply the stats before proceeding with Wayfarer Travel.
9. Fixed various in-game typos.

- You can purchase a 'Golden Key' to open a square using Gold (limited to 5 purchases).
- Completing each bingo line grants line-specific rewards, and additional cumulative rewards are provided based on the number of completed lines.
- The bingo event will rotate every four weeks. The first event will take place from January 6th, 2025 (Monday) to January 12th, 2025 (Sunday).

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1884][Notice - Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New WEMIX PLAY Webshop
1) Introduction of the WEMIX PLAY Webshop and PLAY Token Webshop:
- The WEMIX PLAY Webshop is a new store where you can purchase various items using WEMIX PAY.
- When making purchases that exceed a certain amount via WEMIX PAY, you will earn mileage proportional to the amount spent. Mileage can be exchanged for PLAY Tokens.
- PLAY Tokens can also be purchased using WEMIX$ on PNIX DEX, and these tokens can be spent in the PLAY Token Webshop to purchase items.

2) Important Notice for WEMIX PLAY Webshop and PLAY Token Webshop:
- Item prices will fluctuate based on real-time token values.
- Items purchased with WEMIX through WEMIX PAY are non-refundable.
- Items purchased from the PLAY Token Webshop are also non-refundable.

[b]※ The WEMIX PLAY Webshop content will be introduced in a locked state after the December 10th Update and will officially open later following a separate announcement.[/b]

2. Changes to Valley of Life and Death Rewards
1) MVP Reward (Individual) Changes:
- Wu Yeogi TE Box >  TE Selection Box

2) Season Ranking Reward Changes:
- Wu Yeogi's Gourd > Bok Yangjeo's Tome
- Wu Yeogi TE Box > Bok Yangjeo TE Box

3. Conquest Improvements
Tower of Conquest
- The ‘Reach Character Level’ conditions for each Stage of the Tower of Conquest has been changed.

Tower of Quintessence
- The number of Requests required for Tower of Quintessence Stage Promotion will be reduced by half.

Millennial Tree
- The unlock conditions for the Millennial Tree have been changed to ‘Reach Character Level 32’ and ‘Gather Herbs 10 times.’
- The number of Herbs required for Millennial Tree Stage Promotion has been reduced by 90%.

Tower of Victory
- The unlock conditions for Tower of Victory have been changed to ‘Reach Character Level 34’ and ‘Complete Raid once.’
- The number of Raid attempts required for Stage Promotion has been reduced by half.

Mine
- The unlock conditions for the Mine have been changed to ‘Reach Character Level 30’ and ‘Mine Darksteel 2 times.’
- The amount of Darksteel mining required for Stage Promotion has been reduced by 90%.

Portal
- The number of Magic Square entries required for Stage Promotion in Portal has been reduced by half.

Training Sanctum
- The amount of Energy collection required for Stage Promotion in Training Sanctum has been reduced by 90%.

4. New Appearance Equipment
- Two new costumes for each class: Frog Pubu and Cat Beebee outfits.
[table]
[tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ceccaf72b0f717c145a70810e814de18577ab843.png[/img][/td][/tr]
[tr][th]Frog Pubu Doll Suit & Mask (Left)
Cat Beebee Doll Suit & Mask (Right)
[/th][/tr]
[/table]
5. Drop Rate Adjustments in Hydra's Depths
1) Increased drop rates for specific items obtained by defeating Hydra's Depths boss monsters:
- Target Items: ‘Kthul's Eye’, ‘Twisted Battleseeker's Warding Mark’, ‘Yullus's Spell Ring’, ‘Targan's Shackles’, ‘Ragnos's Cintamani Stone’.

2) New item added to the drop list for the Field Boss <Lord> Ragnos on the 5th floor of Hydra's Depths:
- Red Nebula Powder has been added to the drop list.
- Players who land the final hit on <Lord> Ragnos have a [b]low chance[/b] to randomly obtain 10–30 Red Nebula Powder.

6. Boosting World Mission Pass Expansion
1) Boosting World Mission Pass I missions have been expanded to 40 Stages.
- To support faster growth for Dragonians, the Mission Stages of Boosting World Mission Pass I (Combine, Summon, Enhance) have been expanded to 40 Stages.

7. Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Crafting Item List Updated
- Yellow Dragon Wayfarer crafting item changed.
* The changed crafting can be checked through the Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Event Notice.

[b]■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. [Hydra's Depths] Renamed the ‘<Prophet> Poipoi’ NPC to ‘<Flame Bead Craftsman> Poipoi’.
2. [Boosting World] Changed the Limited Product pop-up so that it is not displayed during the Main Quest Story Mode.
3. [Boosting World] The Limited Product pop-up icon will not appear if there are no items available for purchase.
4. [Quest] Fixed an issue where Darkist characters could not use normal attacks after using their ultimate skill during the Main Quest Story Mode.
5. [Quest] Fixed the name of the NPC for the ‘Rumor's Truth’ quest.
 - Blind Martial Artist > Blind Warrior
6. [Item] Improved the description for ‘Red Nebula Powder’.
 - [You can obtain Flame Bead by processing them through the ‘<Flame Bead Craftsman> Poipoi’ NPC located in <Sanctuary of Hydra>.]
7. [Item] Fixed an issue where the stats of ‘Sealed Drakazan Magical Soul Orb’ and ‘Drakazan Magical Soul Orb Lv. 1’ were reversed.
8. [Skill] Fixed an issue where the cooldown increased debuff for Sweeping Storm was applied incorrectly. 
9. [Portal] Fixed an issue where time spent in the entry queue was being deducted from the time limit.
10. Fixed an issue where some chests and plants in the fields of Bicheon Town could not be collected.
11. Fixed an issue where the safe zone of Ant Hole 2F was incorrectly applied.
12. Changed Wayfarer Travel and NFT Sealing to no longer save unfinished Mystical Piece imprint, Item Enchant, and Magical Soul Orb Enchant stats.
13. Fixed various in-game typos.

[b][November 26th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ Boosting World Server[/b]
1. The Growth-Focused Server <Boosting World Server> is now available! 
- The Boosting World Server is a new server focused on rapid growth, available for a limited time.
- In the Boosting World Server, you can enjoy various benefits like pop-up stores and support passes without needing to worry about World Content such as (e.g., Wayfarer Travel, Expedition, etc.) so that you can focus on your character’s growth and progression.
- In addition to the events held on regular servers, exclusive events tailored for the Boosting World Server will also be available, allowing players to take full advantage of growth benefits.
- Server Schedule: November 26th, 2024 Update - February 18th, 2025 Update

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1828][Game Encyclopedia - Boosting World Server][/url] for further details.

[b]■ New Events[/b]
1. Sweet 7-Day Check-in
2. Piggio's Sweet Chestnut Exchange Shop
3. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1858][Notice - Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Boosting World Server Exclusive Events[/b]
- These events are only available on the new Boosting World Server.
1. Boosting World Welcome 7-Day Check-in
2. Yiun's 28-Day Accumulated Check-in I
3. Ruler of the Boosting World
4. Boosting World Mail Reward
5. Yiun's Boosting World Scroll
6. Boosting World Mission Pass

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1862][Notice - Boosting World Event Round-up][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New Seasonal Token: <EXDRA>
- EXDRA (Expansion of DRACO) is a seasonal token designed to enhance the value of existing tokens.
- EXDRA tokens can be used to craft powerful equipment or traded freely on PNIX DEX.
- The first season of EXDRA tokens runs from November 26, 2024 to May 13, 2025 (24 weeks).
- The token for EXDRA Season 1 is named EXDRA1.
- EXDRA1 tokens have a fixed issuance limit and can be obtained through various methods, such as in-game crafting, Hydra Staking, and Play Token purchases.
- EXDRA Tokens can still be used or traded freely after the season ends.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1853][Game Encyclopedia - EXDRA][/url] for further details.

2. New Equipment: <Ancient Treasure>
- Unlike existing equipment, Ancient Treasures are powerful new equipment that grow sequentially through the ‘Promote’ system.
- Ancient Treasure can be upgraded from Uncommon grade to Mythic grade, with more powerful unique effects unlocked as they progress from Epic grade onward.
- You can craft boxes containing Ancient Treasure in the EXDRA Token Exchange Shop.
- The Ancient Treasure that can be obtained by exchanging EXDRA1 tokens is the ‘Ragnos's Ring.’

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1852][Game Encyclopedia - Ancient Treasure][/url] for further details.

3. New Growth-Oriented Magical Soul Orb: <Special Magical Soul Orb>
- Unlike regular Magical Soul Orbs which have EXP, Special Magical Soul Orbs use a ‘Promote’ system, leveling up by using identical Special Magical Soul Orbs as materials. 
- Special Magical Soul Orbs can be upgraded from Common grade to Mythic grade, with more powerful unique effects unlocked as they progress from Epic grade onward.
- Special Magical Soul Orbs can be crafted from boxes available in the EXDRA Token Exchange Shop.
- The Special Magical Soul Orb that can be obtained by exchanging EXDRA1 tokens is ‘드라카잔 마령주’.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1450][Game Encyclopedia - Special Magical Soul Orb][/url] for further details.

4. New Field: <Hydra's Depths>

1) Hydra’s Depths Floor 1-5
- Hydra's Depths is a new field where you can acquire various materials essential for growth, including those required to Enhance and Enchant Ancient Treasure and Special Magical Soul Orbs.
- You can access the Hydra's Depths through the Sanctuary of Hydra field.
- Floor 5 of Hydra's Depths has been added to the Expedition area, enabling entry through Expedition.

5. PLAY Wallet Login Discontinuation and Transition to WEMIX PLAY Login
- The PLAY Wallet login service, previously used in-game for MIR4 and the XDRACO page, will be discontinued.
- All systems requiring the previous PLAY Wallet login service will be transitioned to the WEMIX PLAY App login system.
- Please refer to the guide below to migrate your existing PLAY Wallet to the WEMIX PLAY App.

※ Please refer to [url=https://wemixplay.com/extra/wp-service-guide][Guide to Changing Wallets][/url] for further details.

6. NFT Transactions Restricted to Mainnet Chain and Unsealing Limited to the Sealed Server
1) Character NFT Transactions Limited to Mainnet Chain
- MIR4 character NFTs can now only be traded via the Mainnet Chain.
※ MIR4 NFTs are based on the Tornado Chain and must remain on the Tornado Chain for creation and use. Switching to the Mainnet Chain to sell your NFT will incur a gas fee (WEMIX).
- The WEMIX PLAY Marketplace (beta), which supported Tornado Chain NFT transactions, will no longer allow new registrations or transactions for Tornado Chain NFTs.
- To trade NFTs listed on the WEMIX PLAY Marketplace (beta), you must retrieve them, convert them to the Mainnet, and sell them via WEMIX PLAY.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1869][Mainnet↔Tornado Chain Conversion Guide][/url] for further details.

2) NFT Unsealing Restricted to the Sealed Server
- The server where the NFT was last sealed will be designated as the ‘NFT Server Info’.
- Purchased character NFTs can only be unsealed on the server specified in their ‘NFT Server Info’.
- If Wayfarer Travel is used to change the server before sealing, the NFT's server will be updated accordingly.

9. All Servers Power Score Ranking System
1) All Servers Power Score Ranking Details
- Overview: The All Servers Power Score Ranking system measures the power score of all Dragonians across all servers and determines rankings to distribute rewards accordingly (this includes the Boosting World Server).
- Ranking Criteria: Rankings are calculated based on power score across all servers, from 1st to 10,000th place.
- How to Check Rankings: Rankings can be viewed in the [Official Forum > Power Score Ranking] section.
- Reward: The ‘Glorious Red Septaria Box’ which contains materials for crafting EXDRA1 tokens.
- Reward Distribution: Rewards are sent via in-game mail once per week (Monday) based on calculated rankings.

- Although the ranking check feature is not yet available, ranking rewards will be distributed starting from December 2nd.
- We are working to complete the ranking check feature as soon as possible, and we will notify all Dragonians upon its completion.

notes.title: [Director’s Commentary] Rapid Growth Server & New Tokenomics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/032e79c8422b869c84223e1f28d9d8b597d0fb2c.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is the MIR4 team.

Through this notice, we are excited to share two main updates planned to be implemented to MIR4.

In addition to the details of the development plans for the second half of 2024, shared through May’s Director's Commentary, the MIR4 team has been preparing updates to maintain the excitement and passion of Dragonians while ensuring the game remains engaging and fun.
Among the many developments in progress, we’d like to highlight two key updates designed to breathe new life into MIR4: the Rapid Growth Server and an innovative tokenomics system.

[h2][b][u]1. BoostingWorld Server (Planned for November)[/u][/b][/h2]

We recognize that MIR4’s expansive content and varied growth paths can create significant progress gaps between new and veteran Dragonians. This disparity makes it harder for new players to find their footing in the game.

In order to solve this issue and reduce the strain and difficulties of growth for new Dragonians, we plan to prepare a server specialized for growth called the BoostingWorld Server. Anyone will be able to grow and become strong enough to enter battles and support your fellow Dragonians!
[list]
[h3][*] A Server Specialized for Growth[/h3]
The BoostingWorld server will offer tailored events and benefits that accelerate growth, allowing new players to catch up more easily and engage in battles alongside their fellow Dragonians. The server will operate for a limited period, after which characters can transfer to a server of their choice.
[/list]

[h2][b][u]2. Innovating Tokenomics (Planned for November)[/u][/b][/h2]

We’re also planning to introduce new tokenomics to complement the existing system, designed to enhance the value of the MIR4 ecosystem. 

Our goal is to strengthen MIR4’s tokenomics and ensure that the time and effort players invest in their characters are reflected in tangible value.

[list]
[h3][*] New growth factor: ‘Ancient Artifact’ and ‘Special Magical Soul Orb’ added.[/h3]
We are adding two powerful new growth items: the Ancient Artifact and the Special Magical Soul Orb. These items will play a central role in the new tokenomics and can be enhanced beyond the Legendary tier, up to Mythic. They will also unlock new passive or party skills, adding a fresh layer of strategy to the battlefield.

[h3][*] Registry and Issuance of New Tokens[/h3]
A new token will be introduced, serving as the key material for crafting the Ancient Artifact and Special Magical Soul Orb. This token will become the foundation of MIR4’s updated tokenomics ecosystem. Players will be able to acquire this token through gameplay, minting, reaching certain ranks in server-wide ranking events, or as a reward in the HYDRA Staking Program (HSP).

[h3][*] Operated in a Season-based schedule[/h3]
The new tokenomics will operate on a seasonal basis. Each new season will see the release of new tokens, ensuring that the total supply of tokens and items for that season is limited. This structure will preserve the value of tokens and items, even after the season concludes.

[h3][*] Tokenomics Reboot[/h3]
With the implementation of the new tokenomics, the following changes will be made to ‘HSP’, ‘MIRAGE’ and ‘EXD’.).
- Staking HYDRA in each season will yield the new season’s tokens through the updated HSP system.
- The number of Hidden Valley in MIRAGE will be adjusted to facilitate the supply of the token and to encourage the competitive aspect of the system.
- Ancient Artifact and Special Magical Soul Orb will become tradable on EXD.
[/list]

This concludes our introduction to our upcoming key update plans.

We will provide further information regarding the mentioned updates and when they shall be implemented through a separate notice or through the patch notes.

We are also actively working on other updates mentioned in the previous Director’s Commentary and aim to release them according to schedule.

We appreciate the ongoing support from our Dragonians, and we will continue to pour our best efforts into improving MIR4.

Thank you.

The MIR4 Development Team

2) New ‘Mystical Piece Imprint’ System
- The Mystical Piece Imprint system is a new feature that allows you to add or change one random ‘Imprint Option’ on Mystical Pieces of rare grade or higher.
- When adding an ‘Imprint Option’ through the Mystical Piece Imprint system, an Imprint Option with a grade between B and SS will be added.
- To perform a Mystical Piece Imprint, you will need a Tablet of the same grade as the Mystical Piece, along with Darksteel and Copper.
- If a Mystical Piece already has an Imprint Option, you can change the effect of the Imprint Option through the Mystical Piece Imprint system.
- When using a ‘Legendary Divine Ancient Tablet’ for the Mystical Piece Imprint, not only will the ‘Imprint Option’ be changed, but the effects of the Mystical Piece’s Basic/Additional Properties’ will also be modified. The ‘Basic/Additional Properties’ will range from Grade C to SS, and the ‘Imprint Option’ will range from Grade B to SS.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/406][Game Encyclopedia - Character][/url] for  additional information on 'Mystical Piece Imprint.'

- Mastery Mystical Piece: Basic ATK DMG Boost
- Defense Mystical Piece: Basic DMG Reduction

5. New Transference Equipment: ‘Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle’
1) The basic options for ‘Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle’ are PHYS ATK and Spell ATK.
- Depending on the Enhance Stage, Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle activates MP/HP/CRIT EVA/CRIT.
- Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle can be obtained through various events, NPC crafting and the Shop.

2) There are 8 Repeatable Achievements for ‘Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle’.
- If you fail to enhance Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle at certain stages, the number of attempts will accumulate, and you can obtain an enhanced Herbalist Hong's Yellow Dragon Golden Needle as an achievement completion reward.

Clan Match is new war content where you can prove your strength against other Clans.
- Clan Match will be held regularly and take place every 8 weeks and will run for 3 weeks.
- Up to 32 Clans can participate in Clan Match. If more than 32 Clans apply, participation will be determined based on Power Score.

- If the scores are tied at the end of the match, the Clan with lower Power Score will be declared the winner.
- The winning Clan advances to the next round, and the Clan that wins the Finals is declared the ultimate winner of Clan Match.

At the end of Clan Match, rewards based on the results and special additional rewards based on individual scores will be distributed.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/7feb88bd3ddb4bb2b5ae0356fc730aa4af1f4201.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

A heartfelt thank you to all our Dragonians who have journeyed with us in MIR4 over the past three years. Your support means the world to us, and we're committed to bringing you even more thrilling adventures in the land of Mir.

As we celebrate our 3rd Anniversary, we've lined up a series of exciting events packed with abundant rewards. Dive in, explore the festivities, and create your own legendary moments across the Mir continent!

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, August 20th.

[b]◈Update Summary◈[/b]
1. New Events: Third Anniversary Thank-You II
2. New ‘Dragon Artifacts’ (5 Types)
3. New Dragon Artifact Categories: ‘Black Dragon Artifact’ and ‘White Dragon Artifact’
4. New ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’ System

[b][August 20th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]■ Events[/b]
1. Third Anniversary Celebration 7-Day Check-in
2. Divine Dragon's Blessing
