4. Third Anniversary Celebration Gold Goblin Exchange Shop
5. Osher's Miraculous Fortune II
6. Third Anniversary Celebration Divine Dragon's Surprise Gift
7. Third Anniversary Community Event: Endless Growth

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1750][Event Round-up][/url] notice for details.

[b]■ Update Details[/b]
1. New ‘Dragon Artifacts’ (5 Types)

Ornate Blade
- All ATK DMG Boost, Bash ATK DMG Boost, CRIT ATK DMG Boost, PHYS ATK, Spell ATK, HP

Heavenly Bell
- PvP ATK DMG Boost, Skill ATK DMG Boost, Accuracy, PHYS ATK, Spell ATK, Monster ATK DMG Boost

Incense Burner
- PvP DMG Reduction, EVA, Antidemon Power, PHYS DEF, Spell DEF, Divine Water Cooldown Reduction

Crescent Jade
- Received Skill DMG Reduction, CRIT EVA, CRIT, PHYS DEF, Spell DEF, Monster DMG Reduction

Bronze Mirror
- All DMG Reduction, Bash DMG Reduction, CRIT DMG Reduction, PHYS DEF, Spell DEF, MP

2. New Dragon Artifact Categories: ‘Black Dragon Artifact’ and ‘White Dragon Artifact’
The Dragon Artifact category is divided into ‘Black Dragon’ and ‘White Dragon’, and the Dragon Artifacts that can be equipped are different for each category.
- 'Black Dragon' Dragon Artifact Category Equipment: Majestic Scepter, Majestic Cape, Majestic Crown, Majestic Seal, Majestic Tome
- 'White Dragon' Dragon Artifact Category Equipment: Ornate Blade, Heavenly Bell, Incense Burner, Crescent Jade, Bronze Mirror

3. New ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’ System
Through ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’, you can transfer a Rare ~ Legendary grade Dragon Artifact to a ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ of the same grade.
- The inherited ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ has higher stats than the existing Dragon Artifact.
- The inherited ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ maintains the existing enhancement stage and enchantment properties.
- Even if a previously tradable Dragon Artifact is inherited, the ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ obtained through ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’ cannot be traded.

4. ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ can be enhanced to a higher level than Dragon Artifact, and will not be destroyed even if enhancement fails.

notes.title: [Director’s Commentary] The Future of MIR4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/032e79c8422b869c84223e1f28d9d8b597d0fb2c.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings to all Dragonians of MIR4.

We would like to send our deepest gratitude towards all Dragonians that showed us so much love throughout the 3 years with MIR4. 

We would like to discuss the future of MIR4 and share with Dragonians our main focus when we are developing, as we have last year. Through this notice, we plan to explain to Dragonians our [b]Development Goals and other key developments planned for the second half of 2024.[/b]

[h2][b][u]1. An Encounter with the Unknown: The Island of the Sky, Prajna[/u][/b][/h2]

To satiate Dragonians’ thirst for challenge and adventure, we continuously updated content and expanded the peak floors of ‘Magic Square’, ‘Secret Peak,’, ‘Tower of Black Dragon’, and added new Mirage Ship Episodes. However, with the high expectations Dragonians must have, we seem to have not hit the mark when it comes to exciting Dragonians with new content. Therefore, we are currently reviewing and making various examinations to create a new area where you can meet and engage in combat with Dragonians of the Korean Server!

[list]
[h3][*] The Island of the Sky, Prajna[/h3]
Although there may be difficulties merging and creating a field area and battlefield due to the system, in-game balance, the different time zones, and other differences in policies of the Global version and Korean version- [b]we began brainstorming for ideas and solutions and we have listed some below.[/b]
- The King Clan of each Region of the Global service can compete with each other, including the Korean Service to compete in a singular World Capture Content.
- MIR4 users all around the world can play cooperatively or in competition with each other in the new area: [The Island of the Sky, Prajna].
[/list]
[list]
[h3][*] Expand Mirage Ship Episode- 7~10 and Tower of Black Dragon[/h3]
The story of the Mirage Ship is reaching its peak! We plan to continue to update Mirage Ship episodes.

The Tower of Black Dragon has been designed to have representative users of each server to participate and are free to cooperate or compete with other users through this content. However we are aware that the level requirement for each floor and the efficiency of the tower is causing a small number of users to take all the rewards for himself/herself, and is also causing a very stagnant combat experience, and we are constantly considering and analyzing how we can improve the experience.

As part of a means to improve the Tower of Black Dragon Content, [b]we plan to expand above the current 4th floor of the Tower, and we plan to make some changes on entry requirements and gameplay mechanics.[/b]
[/list]

[h2][u][b]2. An Arena for Clan Battles: Clan Wars[/b][/u][/h2]

The core of MIR4’s gameplay and community roots from the ‘Clan’ content. We are aware that due to our prolonged service, participating online users have decreased and the fatigue of War content has become rather high. Additionally, Clan communities are currently operated with a variety of specific goals, such as high and medium ranked Clans that Captures and occupies the Valley and the Castle and sub-character Clans that focus on mining and obtaining other resources. 

Due to this, we [b]plan to prepare [Clan Wars] content. With this, we hope to create for Clans and Clan members a reason and a new goal to cooperate among each other.
[/b]
[list]
[h3][*] Clan Wars[/h3]
[Clan Wars] will take place where Clans of all servers will be pitted against each other in a round of 32. It will take place in between Sabuk Clash Seasons, after a Clan wins and becomes an emperor.
Rather than using a complex game mechanic with high stakes at hand, Clan Wars’ design in development will be differentiated by making this [b]content centered around cooperation and collaboration, making it purely an area where clans can duel against each other, with a lighter burden to bear.[/b]
Clan members will once again be able to feel the electrifying bellows that call for war!
[/list]
[list]
[h3][*] Sparring Arena[/h3]
We [b]plan to update a Sparring Arena where you can head into a 5 vs 5, 15 vs 15 combat[/b] to determine the winner. You can create a Sparring Arena just as you can create a Raid and match up with other Dragonians.
We hope this could be a chance for Clans to share combat skills, to communicate with one another, and a chance to start competitions and Live Streams! 
[/list]

[b][u][h2]3. A Mythic Generation! New Challenges and Item Value Preservation[/h2][/u][/b]

As our service has prolonged for some time, Dragonians that reached their peak in combat finesse have started to appear. Due to this, even war is a menial and mundane task for the strongest Dragonian. [b]We plan to grant these Dragonians with a new goal and new visions to reach for.[/b]

We will continue to periodically update the Growth System, while also making sure to prioritize quality when providing expansions. We plan to grant new horizons of growth while also maintaining the value of items.

[list]
[h3][*] Divine Ascension[/h3]
A new [b]Character growth system [Divine Ascension] is planned to be Updated[/b].
[Divine Ascension] will be unlocked once reaching a certain stage of Solitude Training. [Heaven, Earth, Unity, Singularity] tabs will be unlocked and can be enhanced through opening the selected acupoints. 
[/list]
[list]
[h3][*] Black Dragon’s Artifact / White Dragon’s Artifact[/h3]
New Dragon Artifacts: ‘Black Dragon’s Artifact’ / ‘White Dragon’s Artifact’ will be added. The standard Dragon Artifact Item can be transformed into [Black Dragon’s Artifact / White Dragon’s Artifact].
Currently, Dragon Artifacts are rather difficult to craft. We are aware of the limitations brought around by the high possibility of destruction caused by enhancement failure, leading to the tendency to prefer enhancing with Divine Dragon’s Dragon Artifact Enhancement Stones.
In order to improve this, we plan to [b]increase the chances of enhancement using the Dragon Artifact, and remove chances of destruction when enhancing a Dragon Artifact that has been transformed into a [Black Dragon’s Artifact / White Dragon’s Artifact].[/b]
Experience the sheer power and stat boosts the [Black Dragon’s Artifact / White Dragon’s Artifact] grants Dragonians with the addition of improved enhancement chances, through the Transform System.
[/list]
[list]
[h3][*] Descent of the Divine Dragon[/h3]
[b]New content [Descent of the Divine Dragon] will be added.[/b]
You will be able to wield the power of the Divine Dragon, with the magic of Dragon Materials, and Divine Dragon’s Magical Stones.  
Obtain a variety of stat boosts with the power of the Divine Dragon!
[/list]
[list]
[h3][*] Mythic Gear / Mythic Spirits[/h3]
[b]Mythic Graded Gear and Spirits are planned to be added[/b] in the future.
Mythic Grade items will consist of stats that are stronger than items that have been Dragon Forged and enhanced. We will also meticulously design these new items as to not cause any damage or degradation to the standard items currently being used and maintain their value.  
Mythic Grade Items will be differentiated from standard items by granting users with new skills that will grant a new variable to the combat of MIR4.
[/list]


We have shared with you our development plans and goals for future updates. We are truly grateful to Dragonians for showing so much love to MIR4. We will provide you with more details through Patch Notes when the updates mentioned in this notice gets updated into the game.

We hope you are excited for the long journey we have ahead of us, and we hope that Dragonians will continue to cheer us on as we develop new content into our service.

The MIR4 Development Team will do our best as we always have.

Thank you.

Sincerely, the MIR4 Development Team

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, April 16th, 2024.

[b][Main Updates][/b]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Fields in Mirage Ship
- New Mirage Ship areas 'Layer 3 World 2' and 'Layer 3 World 5' have been discovered! With this comes an increase to the maximum level, expansions to Conquest, Constitution, and Inner Force, along with formidable new field bosses and enticing crafting recipes!
2. New ‘Collection Codex’ System
- ‘Collection Codex’ is a new system for characters Level 10 and above that allows you to obtain additional stats based on Codex Completion.
- A new ‘Collection Codex Ranking’ system based on the completion of the ‘Collection Codex’ will provide additional buffs based on your ranking.
- The first collectible item in Collection Codex is ‘Magical Soul Orb’, with more items to be added through future updates.
3. New ‘Spring's Scent’ Events
- Warm Spring's 14-Day Check-In Event
- Dreamfly's Flower Red Bean Jelly Exchange Shop
4. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event
- Don’t miss this chance for an opportunity to acquire a Legendary Magic Stone!
5. New Appearance Equipment
- Go, go Wayfarer Rangers! Get your Lightning weapons and save the continent of Mir!

[b][April 16th Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ New Fields[/b]
● New Fields in Mirage Ship
- New Fields ‘Layer 3 World 2’ and ‘Layer 3 World 5’ have been added.
- With the addition of new Fields, new Main Quests, Missions and Requests have been added.
- You must be level 143 or higher to unlock the new Main Quests in the new Field.

● Maximum Level Increased
- With the addition of new areas, the maximum level has increased from 190 to 200.

● Conquest, Constitution, Inner Force Stages Expanded
▶ Conquest
- The Max Stage for Tower of Conquest, Forge, Mine, Millennial Tree, Training Sanctum, Tower of Quintessence, Tower of Victory, Holy Shrine, and Portal has increased from Stage 25 -> Stage 27.
▶ Constitution
- The Max Tier for Constitution has increased from Tier 21 -> Tier 23 (Max Enhance Level: 115).
▶ Inner Force
- The Max Tier for Nine Yang Manual has increased from Tier 20 -> Tier 22 (Max Enhance Level: 110).
- The Max Tier for Violet Mist Art, Northern Profound Art, Toad Stance has increased from Tier 12 -> Tier 14 (Max Enhance Level: 70).

[b]■ Codex[/b]
● New 'Collection Codex' System
- When you acquire an item required for the Codex, it is automatically registered in the ‘Collection Codex’, and additional Stats can be acquired based on Codex Completion.
- Information registered in the Collection Codex is stored permanently, and once registered items are collected, the registered information does not disappear.
- Stats acquired from Collection Codex are applied on a per-character basis, and Codex information is transferred when an NFT is sealed and during Wayfarer Travel.
- You can check whether each item is collected and its information details in the Collection List.
- The first collectible item in Collection Codex is ‘Magical Soul Orb’.

● New 'Collection Codex Ranking' Based on Collection Codex Completion
- ‘Collection Codex Ranking’ is updated every day at 00:00 (UTC+8), and buff effects are applied based on the ranking.

● New Portal Content: 'Valley of Life and Death'
 - 'Valley of Life and Death' is a large-scale team PvP content where Dragonians from all servers within each region can engage in battles with a normalized playing field.

● 'Valley of Life and Death' Schedule
- 'Valley of Life and Death' will progress in biweekly seasons, with the Valley opening twice daily, for a total of 14 times per season.
- During the opening of 'Valley of Life and Death,' characters of Level 100 or higher can participate up to 3 times a day.
- The first season of 'Valley of Life and Death' will take place from March 25th (Mon) to March 31st (Sun).

● 'Valley of Life and Death' Rules
- 'Valley of Life and Death' will be conducted with 50 players, 5 randomly assigned to each team, for a total of 10 teams. If 50 players are not recruited by the end of the Valley's recruitment time, the game will be automatically canceled.
- All participants in 'Valley of Life and Death' will have the same character (Level 100) and skill level (Tier 8), and their stats will be fixed according to their class.
- In 'Valley of Life and Death,' you can earn activity points by killing boss monsters, enemy characters, resurrecting allied characters, absorbing Stat Beads, and destroying the Cintamani Stone to grow your stats.
- A devastating thunderstorm called the ‘Great Lightning Circle' that inflicts continuous damage will occur in 'Valley of Life and Death' as time progresses, and its range will expand.
- 'Valley of Life and Death' lasts for 12 minutes, and at the end of the game, the team rankings will be determined by combining the score earned by team members.

● 'Valley of Life and Death' Rewards
- If you have obtained at least the minimum individual score at the end of 'Valley of Life and Death,' special reward items will be given based on the team ranking.
- The player with the highest score at the end of 'Valley of Life and Death' will receive the MVP reward.
- At the end of 'Valley of Life and Death,' the individual's score in the Valley will be accumulated in the season ranking, and special rewards will be given based on the season ranking at the end of the season.

● New 'Valley of Life and Death' NPC
- <Soulguiding Badge Exchange Merchant> Soul of Life and Death
- Soulguiding Badge can be obtained as rewards from 'Valley of Life and Death'.

▶ Mir's Blue Cintamani Stone Exchange Shop Event

- Up to 500 Blue Cintamani Stone items can be obtained every day by field hunting or Portal monsters (you cannot obtain Blue Cintamani Stone from Raid or monsters with a level difference of 20 or more).
- Blue Cintamani Stone can be exchanged for various items from the ‘<2024> Mir’ NPC located at each village (Bicheon Castle/Snake Pit/Spiritual Center/Phantasia Desert/Sabuk Castle/Nine Dragon Ice Field/Mirage Ship).
- You can exchange the event item Dragon Battlegear Selection Box to complete the 2024 Blue Dragon Codex!

※ The Event Clan Coin Shop will be available until the update on January 23rd, 2024. 
※ All items acquired from the Event Clan Coin Shop cannot be traded.

[b]■ Equipment[/b]
● New Equipment System: Transference Equipment
- Transference Equipment emerges as a new, mystical gear obtained by forging bonds and bringing aid to enigmatic figures from other worlds around Mirage Ship.
- Transference Equipment can be unlocked and equipped starting from Level 100.
- Transference Equipment can be Enhanced/Enchanted but uses different Enhancement Stones and Enchant Scrolls from those used for existing equipment.
- When enhancing Transference Equipment, specific Enhance Stages grant additional passive effects and stats unlike existing items.
- Transference Equipment can be viewed through [Menu→Character→Secondary Equipment→Transference Equipment].

● Achievement
- Achievement progress can be made based on the number of failed attempts to enhance Transference Equipment, and you can obtain failed enhancement Transference Equipment as a reward.

● Obtaining Transference Equipment
- Transference Equipment can be purchased from the in-game Shop or from the <Darksteel Exchanger> NPC located in Bicheon Castle/Snake Pit/Spiritual Center.

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ Events[/b]
● ‘Yiun and Happiness Sharing’ Event
▶ Happy 7-Day Check-In Event
- Event Period: 2023, December 26th (After Update) ~ 2024, January 8th, 23:59 (UTC +8).
- You can obtain up to 7 special items for logging in daily during the event period.
- Event rewards can be claimed from the fire-cracker shaped icon located on the left side of your screen in-game.

        [td]Mystical Piece Summon Ticket x100[/td]

        [td]Epic Blue Dragon Statue x300[/td]

[b]※ All items claimed from this event cannot be traded.
※ Dragonians must manually claim their daily check-in rewards from the event page each day.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1511][Notice - Happy 7-Day Check-In Event][/url] for further details.[/b]

▶ Yiun and Letter of Happiness Exchange Shop
- Event Period: 2023, December 26th (After Update) ~ 2024, January 8th, 23:59 (UTC +8)
- Letter of Happiness Drop Period: 2024, January 8th, 23:59 (UTC+8)
- Letter of Happiness Exchange Period: 2024, January 15th, 23:59 (UTC+8)
- Up to 1,000 'Letter of Happiness' items can be obtained every day by field hunting or Portal monsters (you cannot obtain ‘Letter of Happiness’ from Raid or monsters with a 20 level difference).
- ‘Letter of Happiness’ can be exchanged for various items from the event NPC ‘<Happy> Yiun’ located at each village (Bicheon Castle/Snake Pit/Spiritual Center/Phantasia Desert/Sabuk Castle/Nine Dragon Ice Field/Mirage Ship).
- You can complete the ‘Happiness Sharing Codex’ by exchanging it for the event item ‘Bell of Happiness’.
※ 'Letter of Happiness' will automatically be removed after the exchange period ends.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1512][Notice - Yiun and Letter of Happiness Exchange Shop][/url] for further details.

▶ Event Ancient Coin Shop
- Event Period: 2023, December 26th (After Update) ~ 2024, January 9th (Before Update)
- During the event period, you can purchase various items with Ancient Coin obtained from Portal and Raid in the Event Ancient Coin Shop (In-Game Shop > Common Product > Event).
※ The Event Ancient Coin Shop is available until 2024, January 9th (before the update).
※ All items acquired through the Event Ancient Coin Shop cannot be traded.

▶ End of the Year & New Year Discount Event
- Event Period: 2023, December 26th (After Update) ~ 2024, January 9th (Before Update)
- During the event period, the 9 products in the ‘Shop > Common Product > Summon’ will be discounted to 2,024 Copper.

■ Spirit
● Legendary Earth Party Leader Spirit: ‘Eighthorns Revenant Destructive Emperor’
- Passive Bonus Once Summoned: PHYS ATK 40
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/6db321713681aa454e6b0d5cb1eb3082da215ccc.png[/img]

    [/tr]

    [/tr]

        [td]Unfaltering Spirit[/td]
        [td]Increases Debilitation RES Boost by 30%, Stun RES Boost by 30%, and Energy Gathering Boost by 10%.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Wail of the Deceased[/td]
        [td]10% chance to reduce the Accuracy of nearby enemies by 500 for 8 seconds on attack. Cooldown 45 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][Party Leader] Horror of the Living[/td]
        [td]Increases the party’s PHYS ATK by 100 and Spell ATK by 100 for 15 seconds on attack. Cooldown 60 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]■ Shop[/b]
● Spirit Special Summon: Eighthorns Revenant Destructive Emperor
- Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Eighthorns Revenant Destructive Emperor’ Special Summon begins!
- Special Summon Period: 2023, December 26th (After Update) ~ 2024, January 23rd (Before Update).

[b]■ Forge[/b]
● Auto-Enhance Feature: Multi-Register System
- When auto-enhancing Weapon/Armor/Accessory/Codex Gear, you can register multiple items with the same enhancement level through Multi-Register.
- You can register up to 12 items at once by pressing the ‘Multi-Register’ button.
- Items that are locked, have maximum enhancement or have [Danger Zone] status cannot be registered.
※ Dragon Artifact items cannot be registered using Multi-Register.

[b]■ Cooperation Mission[/b]
● Cooperation Mission Points Adjusted
- The Cooperation Points earned after completing a Clan Cooperation Mission have been changed from 700 → 450.

[b]■ In-Game Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. Fixed an issue where gathering materials were spawning in inaccessible locations.
2. Fixed issues with certain Castle Siege terrain.
3. Fixed an issue where some of the Arbalist’s Appearance Equipment was abnormally displayed.
4. Fixed an issue where certain monsters could attack outside their attack range.
5. Improved the functionality of ‘Move’ button under specific Mission conditions to navigate to the corresponding Mission tab.
6. Improved various Hotkey functions.
7. Fixed various in-game typos.

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

[b]● 'Magical Soul Orb' System[/b]

- Magical Soul Orb can be upgraded with the new upgrade exclusive items: 'Epic Gold Goblin', 'Rare White Silver Goblin', Epic Grade Spirit Stone, and Magical Soul Orb.

[b]■ Login
● Steam Login Added[/b]
- You can login to MIR4 with a Steam account.
- Steam Account linking can be found under the ‘Linked Accounts’ section within the System menu.

[b]■ Game Client
● Client Engine Updated[/b]
- Android SDK 33 Update will take place. 
- A notification requesting the right for Patch file will be displayed, and you can receive the following notifications upon agreeing with the procedure.

[b]■ Domination Server
● Domination Server Exclusive Content ‘Altar of Black Dragon’[/b]
- Altar of Black Dragon is an exclusive content that can be taken from Domination Labyrinth/Black Dragon Valley/Tower of Black Dragon in Domination Server.
- When built, an advantageous buff effect will be granted to the clan which has built the Altar and Dragonians from the same home server.
- Buff effects will be differentiated per each designated area where the Altar of Black Dragon is built.
- The Altar of Black Dragon can be destroyed by other clans, and allies cannot destroy the Altar.

[b]● Content Criteria[/b]
- Altar of Black Dragon will be qualified for whoever joined in a clan only.
- Clan members of the Clan that have learned the clan technology (Surprise Attack II) can occupy the Altar of Black Dragon placed in the designated area except for the ‘New Clan Members’
- Altar of Black Dragon Summon Badge can be crafted from NPC <Scute Collector> Uhm Jinho located at the [Domination] Sabuk Castle.
- ‘Altar of Black Dragon Summon Badge’ Crafting resources: Legendary Black Dragon’s Essence x1, Legendary White Dragon’s Essence x1, 500,000 Copper

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/a7e589ef36b41e20217bb1534946636a9c1cf5d3.png[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, May 2nd, 2023.

=========================

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Character Growth System: ‘Potential’
- Unlock your character’s full Potential and unleash your true power!
2. ‘Potential’ 7-Days Check-In Event
- Obtain items that will help realize your character’s Potential by logging in every day during the event!
3. New Appearance Equipment: Back Ornaments
-  Carry your dungeon loot in style with these new back ornaments!

=========================

[h3][May 2nd Patch Note Details][/h3]

◈In-Game Updates◈

[b]■ Training[/b]
[b]● New Character Growth System: 'Potential'[/b]
- The new character growth system ‘Potential’ can be accessed from the ‘Training’ menu (Menu > Training > Potential) once your character reaches Level 90.
- Potential consists of 3 types (Hunt/PVP/Secondary), and depending on the type of Potential, the inner stats and passive skills that can be learned differ.
- Potential is a system that allows you to grow sequentially from the lower stages by using materials required for training (Skill Tomes, Dragonsteel, etc.).
- The probability of Success depends on each spot point of the stage you’re currently at.
- You can learn new passive skills by growing your Potential to certain levels.

[b]※ Please refer to [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/319]Game Encyclopedia - Training[/url]] for further details.[/b]

[b]■ Event[/b]
[b]● ‘Potential’ 7-Day Check-In Event[/b]
- Event Period: From the May 2nd Update Maintenance to May 15, 23:59 (UTC+8).
- Obtain special items such as Rare/Epic Dragonsteel Boxes and Skill Tome Summon Tickets to help train your Potential every day by logging in daily during the event period.
- Tap the fire-cracker shaped icon in-game to claim the event rewards.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Day 1[/th]
        [th]Day 2[/th]
        [th]Day 3[/th]
        [th]Day 4[/th]
        [th]Day 5[/th]

        [th]Day 7[/th]

        [td]Skill Tome Summon Ticket x5[/td]
        [td]Rare Dragonsteel Box x2l[/td]
        [td]Skill Tome Summon Ticket x10[/td]
        [td]Skill Tome Summon Ticket x10[/td]
        [td]Epic Dragonsteel Box x1[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]※ All claimed items cannot be traded or stored.
※ Dragonians must manually claim their daily check-in rewards from the event page each day.[/b]

[b]■ Crafting Manual[/b]
[b]● Event Crafting Manual[/b]
- Craft NPC: <Craftsman> Gwon Chuyoung
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Crafts[/th]

 [/tr]

        [td]100 Copper[/td]
 [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Epic Spirit Treasure Box[/td]
        [td]Legendary Spirit Treasure Token x1[/td]
        [td]100 Copper[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]■ Shop[/b]
[b]● Notifications for Storage[/b]
- When you receive a Gift, a notification will be shown on the Shop and Gift Storage (Received) tab.
- When you purchase a product that can be Gifted, a notification will be shown on the Gift Storage (For Sending) tab.
- When you purchase products, a notification will be shown on the Storage tab.

[b]● The name 'Divine Dragon's Promise' on Legendary Spirit Summon will change to 'Divine Dragon's Promise Ⅱ'.[/b]

[b]■ Appearance Equipment[/b]
[b]● 2 New Back Ornaments will be added.[/b]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/d6859ac135cd535ec9a82852372ac6035a3d42bf.png[/img][/th]

 [/tr]

        [td]Lovely Youth Bag[/td]
        [td]Antique Youth Bag[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]● Weapon Exchange Ticket Resale[/b]
- Weapon Exchange Ticket: Season II can now be purchased again from the Shop.

[b]■ Chat[/b]
[b]● Chat Notification For Gifts[/b]
- When you receive a Gift, a notification from the sender will be delivered through Whisper.

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Fixed the issue where the Party was occasionally disbanded after the completion of Clan Expedition.
2. Fixed the issue where the character would not Auto-Move while proceeding with a specific request in Phantom Woods.
3. Fixed the issue of specific mysteries that were unable to be processed.
4. Fixed various in-game typos.

notes.title: Patch Note - April 4th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/a7e589ef36b41e20217bb1534946636a9c1cf5d3.png[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.
We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, April 4th, 2023.

=========================

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. Tower of Black Dragon 4F Unlocked!
- Unleash your true potential and conquer the Tower of Black Dragon's 4th floor! Gear up and brace yourself for a thrilling challenge that promises a wealth of amazing rewards!
2. New Equipment Enhancement: Dragon Forge
- Forge your path to supremacy with Dragon Forge and enhance  your Legendary IV Tier equipment to its ultimate form.
3. New Epic Spirit: Dark Assassin Zakhan
- Harness the deadly power of the new Epic Forest Spirit, Dark Assassin Zakhan! Boost your skills with a passive +20 Spell ATK bonus, and dominate the competition with powerful skills like Echolocation, Guano Pill, and Vitality Extortion!
4. New Equipment Appearance: ‘Radiant Youth’
- School your enemies with the new Radiant Youth outfit!
5. New Mount: ‘White Wayfarer Cat’
- Say hello to your new purr-fect ride - the White Wayfarer Cat mount!

[b]◈Official Forum Update◈[/b]
1. Criteria for signing in the official Forum changes.
- The criteria for signing in to the official Forum will change to comply with the global privacy policy.

=========================

[h3][April 4th Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈
■  Portal
● Tower of Black Dragon 4F is now available.[/b]
 - Required Level : Level 135 or above
 - Required Power Score : 159,700
 - Monster Level : 155~180

[b]● Tower of Black Dragon 4F Exclusive content[/b]
 - Monster ‘Diabolic Skydragon’ will have a 10% chance of being summoned by defeating the Field Boss 'Juja Neoul'.

[b]● Crafting Manuals for Summon Badge in Tower of Black Dragon[/b]
  1) Tower of Black Dragon 2F:
 - 3-player Boss Monster: Moska Summon Badge (x1)+ Dragonsteel (x1) = Lazaison Summon Badge (x1).
 - 5-player Boss Monster: Ganiyado Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x2) = Kaguiv Summon Badge (x1).
 - 10-player Boss Monster: Dreadhide Dragon Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x4) = Deranged Darkwing Summon Badge (x1).

 2) Tower of Black Dragon 3F:
 - 3-player Boss Monster: Lazaison Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x2) = Lifedeath Dragon Summon Badge (x1).
 - 5-player Boss Monster: Kaguiv Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x4) = Makaraz Summon Badge (x1).
 - 10-player Boss Monster: Deranged Darkwing Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x8) = Monstrum Summon Badge (x1).

3) Tower of Black Dragon 4F:
 - 3-player Boss Monster: Lifedeath Dragon Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x5) = Demonic Termina Summon Badge (x1).
 - 5-player Boss Monster: Makaraz Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x10) = Trine Termina Summon Badge (x1).
 - 10-player Boss Monster: Monstrum Summon Badge (x1) + Dragonsteel (x20) = Unhallowed Termina Summon Badge (x1).

[b]■  Forge
● New Equipment Enhancement Feature, 'Dragon Forge' is Now Available[/b]
 - Use the Dragon Forge on Legendary IV Tier equipment to increase their stats.
 - Dragon Forge consists of 7 stages, each requiring 4 specific materials and a set amount of resources to progress.
 - Legendary White and Black Dragon Essence are new materials required for Dragon Forge, which can be obtained from various contents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/1543d7d33da65a8d17f1adfe5620e563be891cbc.png[/img]
 - Items that are available for Dragon Forge
・Weapon (Weapon, Secondary Weapon)
・Armor (Top, Bottom, Gloves, Shoes)
・Accessory (Necklace, Bracelet, Ring, Earring)

[b]※ The Success Chance for Dragon Forge varies per stage, and the targeted equipment will not be destroyed if the forging fails.
※ Please refer to Game Encyclopedia > Forge > [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/34][Dragon Forge][/url] for further details.[/b]

[b]■ Spirit
● New Epic Forest Spirit ‘Dark Assassin Zakhan’ will be added.[/b]
Passive Bonus Once Summoned : Spell ATK +20
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/65e24df5784f531368d539c366065024a2d54873.png[/img]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill[/th]
        [th]Skill Effect[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Echolocation[/td]
        [td]Increases Max HP by 1600, Max MP by 500, Skill DMG Reduction by 15%, and Bash ATK DMG Boost by 25%.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Guano Pill[/td]
        [td]Increases Antidemon Power by 10%, Skill HP Recovery Am't Boost by 15%, and Stun Success Boost by 20%, and reduces Skill MP Cost by 5%.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Vitality Extortion[/td]
        [td]Upon attacking an enemy with a Bash, there is a 10% chance to recover 5% of Max HP and 8% of Max Vitality. Cooldown 30 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]■ Item
● Addition of Material Items[/b]
 - 2 materials required for Dragon Forge have been added:
 - Legendary White and Black Dragon Essence
 - Source to Obtain
・Legendary Gathering/Energy : Legendary White Dragon Essence
・Legendary Mining/Darksteel : Legendary Black Dragon Essence
・Completion Reward for Clan Challenge Stage 4 or above
・Completion Reward for Raids that are more difficult than Wailing Dead Mine and Boss Raid that are more difficult than Nefariox King
・Hell Raid Completion Reward
・Defeat Reward obtainable from Boss monster ‘Juja Neoul’ or ‘Diabolic Skydragon’ in Tower of Black Dragon 1~4F
・Craftings from NPC ‘Millennial Fox Solari’ in Arcadia Spirit Village.

[b]※ The new materials may be granted with tradable property with a low chance.[/b]

[b]● Item Drop Source Expanded[/b]
 - The additional acquisition route for Drum of Victory, Portrait, and Monster hunting-themed event items will be updated.
 - Source to Obtain
・Magic Square 1F~9F
・Secret Peak 1F~9F

[b]● Increase in the Item Drop Chance of certain items in Magic Square and Secret Peak[/b]
 - The Drop Chance for Epic Eternal Snow Panax and Epic Azureum Mineral Fluid will be increased in Magic Square/Secret Peak 4F~9F.

[b]■ Outfit
● ‘Radiant Youth’ outfits for MIR4 characters are now available![/b]
 - The outfit is purchasable with the Radiant Youth Exchange Ticket.
・Radiant Youth
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5d009a05d5bc5a50eb5e2d550308630dcfbe0955.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Mount
● New Mount ‘White Wayfarer Cat' [/b]
 - You can exchange the new mount with [White Wayfarer Cat Exchange Ticket].
・White Wayfarer Cat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/c5d39e372d6b0eb37a8b2871fb25453c984720ef.png[/img]

[b]◈Official Forum Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ Sign in condition changes
1) Guest login for the Official Forums (Dragonian_No.) will no longer be available.[/b]
 - The temporary nickname given before setting a Representative Character has been removed.
 - You now need a MIR4 game account to use the official forum.
2) If no Representative Character has been set, the character with the highest level will be automatically set as the Representative Character.
 - You can also change the Representative Character on your own.
3) You must agree to the MIR4 Terms of Use and Privacy policy to use specific features on the Official Forum.
 - To access specific features, such as 1:1 inquiry or registering a coupon, which require your private information, you must agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy of MIR4.

[b]※ Posts (notices, patch notes, etc.) that do not require any private information can be viewed without signing in.[/b]

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Improved Camera functionality to zoom in and out seamlessly on every menu, perfectly aligned with the actual gameplay for a more immersive and cohesive experience.
 - Implemented on: Equipment, Basic Info/Other User’s Info,  Mystical Piece, Outfit, and Wearable costumes.
2. Improved the Source of items that can be obtained (such as from Divine Dragon's Promise) to be viewable.
3. Fixed the issue where the HP of the Boss Monster 'Warswine King' in the 'Forgotten Area' was abnormally reset upon receiving the 'Knocked-Out’ status.
4. Fixed the issue where monsters in a specific location in Dead Mine 3F occasionally move to an unattackable position.
5. Fixed the item name ‘Rare Noirsoul Herb Box’ that was being displayed as 0.

notes.title: Patch Note - March 21st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/a7e589ef36b41e20217bb1534946636a9c1cf5d3.png[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings, This is MIR4. 

We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, March 21st, 2023.

[b][Main Updates][/b]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. Sabuk Clash Update
- Prepare for an epic region-based war to claim the throne of the Sabuk Emperor and prove your clan's might in this ultimate battle for power and glory!
2. Rule the Territory
- Rule your territory with unrivaled power as Emperor of the Sabuk Castle!
3. Party Leader Spirit: Red Eyes Lucy
- Check out MIR4’s newest Legendary Spirit which grants an additional buff for the party when summoned by the Party Leader.
4. Special Sabuk Clash Events!
- Come celebrate the release of Sabuk Clash and earn a bounty of rewards by participating in our exciting range of events!
5. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event
- Back by popular demand, the Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event is here to offer you another chance to summon an elusive Legendary Magic Stone!

[b][March 21st Patch Note Details][/b]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ War[/b]
● Sabuk Clash - The Grand Scale of War is Here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/e940c75e27044737f26992b49e24093496c89008.jpg[/img]
- Sabuk Clash is a region-based war among Kings and their clan from all servers, who will then assemble in the Domination Server to fight for the title of Emperor of Sabuk Castle.
- Sabuk Clash will last for 3 weeks and consist of 3 Gateways under 1 weekly-cycle (Attack Route, Castle Gate, and Sabuk Castle). Clans who succeed in engraving the Monolith will be qualified to proceed to the next stage.
- The clan leader of the clan who wins the final round (Gateway 3) will be crowned as Emperor of Sabuk Castle.
- The Emperor rules over the Sabuk Castle Territory and has the rights to adjust the tax rate, declare Imperial Decrees, assign Imperial Titles, and distribute Prizes.
※ If no Monolith has been engraved from the 1st and 2nd Sabuk Clash Gateways, the Sabuk Clash will automatically end and the title of Emperor will remain vacant until a King and their clan is victorious in Sabuk Clash.
※ Sabuk Clash Gateway 1 will begin on Sunday, March 26, 2023 and the following stages will take place a week after (7-day cycle).

[b]■ Territory[/b]
● The emperor rules the Sabuk Castle territory under his or her reign.
- The Emperor who has won the Sabuk Clash will have a right to rule the Sabuk Castle Territory.
- The Emperor can use features referred to below.

1) Appoint Position
> The Emperor can appoint a government position to king clan members to aid your ruling.
2) Use Tax of Sabuk Castle Territory
> The Emperor can manage taxes accumulated in Sabuk Castle Storage.
3) Adjust Tax Rate
> The Emperor can adjust the tax rate of each currency charged from home servers under your reign.
4) Prizing
> The Emperor can select a specific character to award him or her.
5) Imperial Title
> You can select a clan in the region where the Emperor belongs and grant an imperial title to the clan.
6) Emperor exclusive mount
> Only the Emperor can purchase or ride the mount ‘Sabuk Destrier’ .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/af7077ecdc2e18aefaeb2af1e5fd7338e5088b6a.png[/img]
7) Exclusive Symbol
> An exclusive symbol will be available for Emperor's Clan only.
8) Imperial Decree
> The Emperor can select a specific server in home server to declare or lift the Imperial Decree.
9) Emperor's Utterance
> Messages from the Emperor will be shown on all servers in the region.
10) Proclamation
> Bicheon King : Only Bicheon King can use this feature to distribute mails to the server where the King belongs.
> Sabuk Emperor : Only Sabuk Emperor can use this feature to distribute mails to the region where the emperor belongs.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia > [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1239][Sabuk Clash][/url] for further details.

[b]■ Spirit[/b]
● New Legendary Earth Spirit ‘Red Eyes Lucy’ will be added.
- Passive bonus once summoned: PHYS ATK +40
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2c45b731bbadb0292b4e347b1af89a2da2289965.png[/img]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill[/th]
        [th]Skill Effect[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Grooming[/td]
        [td]Increases Max HP by 2000, Max MP by 800, PHYS ATK by 90, and Spell ATK by 90.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Sense of Balance[/td]
        [td]Increases PvP ATK DMG Boost by 15%, PvP DMG Reduction by 15%, Stun RES Boost by 25%, and Silence RES Boost by 25%.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Meow Meow Punch[/td]
        [td]Increases Knockdown Success Boost by 20% and MP Potion Use Effect by 5%, and speeds up Gathering Time and Mining Time by 10%.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Perseverance[/td]
        [td]Upon resurrection, increases PHYS DEF and Spell DEF by 90 and Debilitation RES Boost by 20% for 10 sec. Cooldown 20 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][Party Leader] Burning Eyes[/td]
        [td]Upon killing a character, increases the party's All ATK DMG Boost by 3% for 30 sec (max 5 stacks). Cooldown 1 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]■ Shop[/b]
● Legendary Spirit Summon will reset.
- The Legendary Spirit ‘Red Eyes Lucy’ can be obtained from the Legendary Spirit Summon.
- The chance to obtain this Legendary Spirit will be doubled, and an ‘X2 UP’ icon will be displayed during the period below:
- Period: Begins after the March 21 Update and will last until the April 18 Update (UTC+8).

● 3 Exchange Tickets referred to below can be purchased again from Shop.
- Target : Hat Exchange Ticket Season II, Back Ornament Exchange Ticket Season II, Outfit Exchange Ticket Season II
- Sale Period : Begins after March 21 Update and lasts until April 18 Update.

■ Event
● Events to Commemorate the Sabuk Clash Update!
1. Darkness 14-Day Check In
1) Event Period
- Begins after March 21 Update and last until April 3, 23:59(UTC+8), 2023
2) Event Details
- You can obtain 7 special items for logging in daily during the event period.
- We will support your growth with Luckster’s Rare, Epic and Legendary Potion Box.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1243][Notice - Luckster's Sabuk Clash 7-Day Cheer Check-in][/url] for further details.

2. The Age of War 14-Day Check-in
1) Event Period
- From March 27, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC+8) to April 17, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+8).
2) Event Details
- You can obtain 14 special items for logging in daily during the event period.
- We will support your growth with various items including Epic Divine Dragon’s Enhancement Stone.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1244][Notice - The Age of War 14-Day Check-in][/url] for further details.

3. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event
1) Event Period
- From March 27, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC+8) to March 29, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+8).

2) Cost
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Type[/th]
        [th]1 Summon [/th]
        [th]10+1 Summons[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Magic Stone[/td]
        [td]100,000 Darksteel[/td]
        [td]1,000,000 Darksteel[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
※ 1 Free Summon will be provided daily.

3) Notes
- You can participate in the event through the fire-cracker-shaped icon that can be found at the top left corner in-game.
- The maximum limit for Event Summons per day is 110 Summons (10+1 Summon x10), and the total limit for the entire event period is 330 Summons. (1 Free Summon per day excluded).
- The Daily Summon Count will reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+8).
- The accumulated Event Incense Burner points will be deleted after the event period (Event Incense Burner points only).
- Please be aware that all Event Incense Burner points accumulated from previous Legendary Magic Stone Challenge events will be reset every time this event starts.

※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1236][Notice - Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event][/url] for further details.

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Improved the notification message display for items which do not have a source to obtain from. 
2. Fixed the issue in Clan Alliance Chat that displayed the chats from alliances of different servers which appeared to look like they were sent from the same server.
3. Fixed the issue that occurs when hiding the appearance of Wearable Mount.
4. Improved the description of Divine Dragon’s Restoration Box.
5. Improved the description of Creating/Sealing the NFT character.
6. Improved the following Repeatable Mission Rewards:
- Phantasia Valley 1F ~ 4F: Darksteel/Energy > Rare Mineral Fluid/Snow Panax
- Phantasia Valley 1F ~ 4F: Rare Enhancement Stone > Epic Ice Crystal
- Sagittarion Valley 1F~4F : Rare Ice Crystal > Epic Ice Crystal 
7. Improved the difficulty of requests in the Domination Server.
- In Search of Dragon Pulse 1 : [Domination] Defeat number of monsters in Sabuk Labyrinth 4F from 6000 -> to 3000.
- In Search of Dragon Pulse 2 : [Domination] Defeat number of Uniques in Sabuk Labyrinth 4F from 120 to 40.
8. Lowered the maximum HP of Krukan, the Demon Spider of Hell.

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, February 21, 2023.

=========================

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Portal Stage: Magic Square / Secret Peak 9F
- You can now obtain more EXP and rewards with the addition of Magic Square and Secret Peak 9F.
2. New Legendary Spirit: Luminous Setra
-  Check out MIR4’s newest Legendary Spirit which grants an additional buff for the party when summoned by the Party Leader.
3. Divine Dragon’s Promise II added to Legendary Spirit Summon
- You can now get Divine Dragon’s Promise points from Legendary Spirit Summons!
4. New Event: Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge
- Don't miss this chance to obtain Legendary Spirit Treasures!
5. Favorites feature added to Mini-map
- Enjoy quicker and more convenient gameplay with the newly added Favorites feature in the Mini-map, where you can save your favorite spots with one click. 

[b]◈XDRACO Updates◈[/b]
1. New System: WEMIX$ Payment
- In-game products can now be purchased using pWEMIX$ instead of HYDRA.

[b]◈Terms of Service Amendments◈[/b]
1. Amendments to global Privacy Policy
- A new privacy policy will be implemented for MIR4 to comply with related global laws and regulations in order to further protect your personal information.

=========================

[h3][February 21st Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ Portal
● Portal stage 9F will be added.[/b]
-9F will be added to Magic Square and Secret Peak for Expeditions.

[b]● Magic Square 9F[/b]
-Entry Power Score: 140,800
-Monster Level: 145–160

[b]● Secret Peak 9F[/b]
-Entry Power Score: 146,000
-Monster Level: 150–160

[b]● Expedition Missions for Portal 9F will be added.[/b]
-1 Magic Square Expedition Mission
-7 Secret Peak Expedition Missions
[b]● Crafting manuals for Summon Badge in Secret Peak 9F will be added.[/b]

[b]■ Spirit
● Legendary grade light spirit ‘Luminous Setra’ will be added.[/b]

    [/tr]

        [td][Party Leader] Brilliant Shield[/td]
        [td]Increases the Party’s PHYS DEF and Spell DEF by 350 for 15 sec on attack. Cooldown 60 sec.[/td]

[/table]
[b]■ Shop
● Legendary Spirit Summon will be reset.[/b]
- The Legendary Spirit ‘Luminous Setra’ can be obtained from the Legendary Spirit Summon.
- The chance to obtain this Legendary Spirit will be doubled, and an ‘X2 UP’ icon will be displayed during the period below:
- Period: Begins after the February 21 Update and will last until the March 21 Update (UTC+8).

[b]● ‘Divine Dragon’s Promise II’ will be added to Legendary Spirit Summon.[/b]
- Divine Dragon's Promise points can now be gathered from Legendary Spirit Summon.
- The ‘Divine Dragon’s Blue Dragon Statue Box’ can be obtained by gathering 1,000 points in Divine Dragon’s Promise II.
- Please note that a minimum of 5 to a maximum of 30 "Legendary Blue Dragon Statue" items can be obtained by using ‘Divine Dragon’s Blue Dragon Statue Box’ with a random chance.

[b]● Spirit Special Summon Ends[/b]
-  The Spirit Special Summon for "Redhorn Komet" will end.

[b]■ Event
● Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event will be added.[/b]
1) Event Period
- From February 27, 2023, 00:00 until March 1, 2023, 23:59 (UTC+8).
2) Costs
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Type[/th]

    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Spirit Treasure[/td]
        [td]100,000 Darksteel[/td]
        [td]1,000,000 Darksteel[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]※ 1 Free Summon will be provided daily.[/b]
3) Caution
- You can participate in the event through the fire-cracker-shaped icon that can be found at the top left corner in-game. 
- The maximum limit for Event Summons per day is 110 Summons (10+1 Summon x10), and the total limit for the entire event period is 330 Summons. (1 Free Summon per day excluded).
- The Daily Summon Count will reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+8).
- The accumulated Event Incense Burner points will be deleted after the event period (Event Incense Burner points only).
- Please be aware that all Event Incense Burner points accumulated from previous Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge events will be reset every time this event starts.
[b]※ Please refer to [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1198][Notice] Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event[/url]] for further details.[/b]

[b]● Adjustment in Item Drop chances in the ‘Portrait’ Event[/b]
- The chance of acquiring Portrait items will be doubled.

[b]● Sweet Summon Ticket Discount Event Ends[/b]
- The discount on the 9 products that can be purchased with Copper in the Shop (Common and Summon Ticket) will end. 

[b]■ Mini-Map
● Favorite feature will be added to Mini-map.[/b]
- Open the Mini-map and tap the star-shaped icon located on the right side to save your favorite spots or NPCs. 
- When saved, each Favorite icon color will change, and the Favorites icon at the top right of the Mini-map will be activated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ac6fdbda6a3b5c85a34e44a7625abc6a11a41607.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/83cbfdf0b70c91accbe8e153521c8c5a27cf7556.png[/img]
- Simply tap the activated Favorites icon to move to that location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5fe1cea83ca1ee0fa5628d844ade70f659ad5c52.png[/img]
- Up to 10 locations can be registered as Favorites.

[b]■ Enhancement
● A warning pop-up that displays the Destruction Chances will be shown during Enhancement or Special Enhancement.[/b]
- When doing an Enhancement or Special Enhancement of an item that could be destroyed, a warning pop-up will be displayed, alerting players of the Destruction Chances before proceeding with Enhancement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f1f863978f803942e28d82a9533fa0b37bd28bfc.png[/img]

[b]◈XDRACO Updates◈
■ WEMIX$ Payment
● WEMIX$ Payment system will be added.[/b]
- The newly implemented WEMIX$ Payment system will make it possible for in-app purchases to be made with pWEMIX$ instead of HYDRA.
- Through the WEMIX$ Payment system, you no longer need to compare the market price changes of the tokens, making it easier to check the price and proceed with the purchase more intuitively. 
- HYDRA currently in your balance can be exchanged with pHYDRA with a 1:1 ratio in PLAY Wallet or swapped with pWEMIX$ on the WEMIX PLAY website.

[b]＊What is pWEMIX$?[/b]
-pWEMIX$ is a currency that can be used for games serviced within the WEMIX platforms and can be obtained by converting WEMIX$.    

[b]※ pWEMIX$ Payment can only be made in the PC version of the game (Xsolla).
※ No refunds can be issued for purchases made with pWEMIX$.
※ Please refer to [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1201]WEMIX$ Payment Update[/url]] or [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/757]Game Encyclopedia > [WEMIX$ Payment[/url]] for further details.[/b]

[b]◈Amendments on Terms of Services◈
■ Amendments to Global Privacy Policy[/b]
● The new Privacy Policy will be implemented after the update on February 21, 2023.
- The new policy aims to enhance the security of customers’ personal information by complying with global privacy laws and regulations.
- Please refer to the links below for further information.

- [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/policy/privacy]Privacy Policy will come into effect on February  21, 2023[/url]] 
- [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/policy/california]California Privacy Statement will come into effect on February  21, 2023[/url]]

[b]※ Please be aware that upon logging into the game, a pop-up will appear and ask you to agree to the new policy after these amendments are in effect. [/b]

[b]■ In-Game Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/b]
1. Changed the in-game visuals when obtaining items according to its grade.
2. Adjusted the number of required monsters hunted in all field-based Cooperation Missions.
3. Adjusted the number of required Treasure Box items in [Mission] Treasure Hunter from 50 to 30.
4. Improved the display properties of XDRACO items shown in the Chat window through the 'Share' feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/19e32771b954b56b9ad86343c508e0abeb9e5689.png[/img][b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]
Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, February 7th, 2023.
=========================
[Main Updates]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Boss Raid: ‘Heavenly Asura’
- Defeat the new boss and obtain rewards.
2. New Raid: ‘Forgotten Arena’
- Prove your might by completing the new raid.
3. Solitude Training: Inner Force Loci added

- Sweet 14-Day Check in added.
- Cupid Bihoyo’s Red Bean Jelly Exchange Shop will be opened.
- Sweet Summon Ticket Discount Event added.
5. New Epic Spirit: Redhorn Komet
- Check out MIR4’s new Earth spirit.
6. Favorites to Raid, Expedition, and Portal will be added.
- You can use those playable contents more conveniently.
7. Level restriction on Chats to all channels will be changed.

=========================

[February 7th Patch Note Details]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
■ Raid
● New Boss Raid ‘Heavenly Asura’ will be added.
- Boss Name: Heavenly Asura
- Boss Level: 170
- Entry Power Score: 134,000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/bac5e718cb006eea35808b2112887bc7b58aa739.png[/img]

● New Raid ‘Forgotten Arena’ will be added.
- Boss Name: Warswine King
- Boss Level: 175
- Entry Power Score: 154,000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/6da3084157d9a2fd864a0a8fabe00a342df5dc5c.png[/img]

[b]■ Solitude Training[/b]
● New Inner Force Veins for Solitude Training will be added.
- New Blood vessels added: Yang Heel Vessel, Yin Heel Vessel, Yank Link Vessel, Yin Link Vessel
- The Max stage for Overall Tier will be the same as the previous. (God Realm Lv.10)
- Minimum Level Requirement : 130

[b]■ Event[/b]
● New Event ‘Sweet Flutter of Love’ will be added.
♥ 1st Event : Sweet 14-Day Check in
- You can obtain Check-in rewards by logging in daily during the event period.
- Event Period: After February 7th Update, 2023-March 6th, 2023, 23:59:59 (UTC+8)
Day 1 : Epic Mystic Enhancement Stone x1
Day 2 : Rare Ice Crystal x50
Day 3 : Epic Blue Dragon Statue x10
Day 4 : Epic Darkened Enhancement Stone x1
Day 5 : Rare Divine Dragon’s Dragon Artifact Enhancement Stone x1
Day 6 : Rare Divine Dragon’s Enhancement Stone x2
Day 7 : Legendary Blue Dragon Statue x1
Day 8 : Epic Mystic Enhancement Stone x2
Day 9 : Rare Dragonsteel Box  x5
Day 10 : Epic Blue Dragon Statue x10
Day 11 : Epic Darkened Enhancement Stone x2
Day 12 : Rare Divine Dragon’s Enhancement Stone x2
Day 13 : Epic Divine Dragon’s Enhancement Stone x1
Day 14 : Legendary Blue Dragon Statue x1

♥ 2nd Event : Cupid Bihoyo’s Red Bean Jelly Exchange Shop
- You can obtain 'Red Bean Jelly' in all in-game content other than in Portal and Raid during the event period. Visit the event NPC to exchange this item with various items.
- Item Drop Period: After February 7th Update-February 20th, 2023, 23:59:59 (UTC+8)
-Item Exchange Period: After February 7th Update-February 27th, 2023, 23:59:59 (UTC+8)
- Up to 1,000 'Red Bean Jelly' can be obtained every day.
- The ‘Red Bean Jelly’ item will be deleted after the exchange period mentioned above.

● Exchange NPC: <Cupid> Bihoyo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/002047943fa926cddd8cb028e35ed7a5daffc008.png[/img]
- Location: Bicheon Castle/Snake Pit/Spiritual Center/Phantasia Desert/Sabuk Castle/Nine Dragons’ Ice Field

♥ 3rd Event : Sweet Summon Ticket Discount Event
- Event Period: After Update Maintenance on February 21st, 2023-Before March 7th Update Maintenance
- 9 shop products purchasable by copper will be discounted to 214 copper during the event period.
- Chance to obtain Rare and Epic items from the 9 normal summons will be doubled during the event.

[b]■ Spirit[/b]
● New Epic Earth Spirit ‘Redhorn Komet’ will be added.
- Passive bonus once summoned: PHYS ATK +20
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/016097bae3a77f6f0e65cc09153c32cdc69a8041.png[/img]
-Skill/Effect
1)Surge of Power! : Increases Max HP by 3000, PHYS ATK by 90, and Spell ATK by 90.
2)Shiny Horn : Increases Antidemon Power by 15%, Skill ATK DMG Boost by 15%, and Hunting EXP Gain by 18%.
3)Resolute Will : Upon taking CRIT DMG, increases CRIT EVA by 100 for 15 sec and increases EVA by 300 for 5 sec. Cooldown 60 sec.

[b]■  Domination Server[/b]
● Improvement to the amount of EXP by hunting monsters in the Tower of Black Dragon.
- Hunting EXP obtained from monsters will be increased.
- Number of spawned monsters will be increased.
- Reduction in the spawn time of monsters will be applied.

[b]■ Shop[/b]
● 3 types of Outfit Exchange Tickets will be sold again.
- Target on sale: Hat Exchange Ticket Season 1/Back Ornament Exchange Ticket Season 1/Outfit Exchange Ticket Season 1

[b]■ War[/b]
● Difficulty of Clan War will be changed.
- Contents changed: Hidden Valley Capture, Castle Siege, Sanctuary, Tower of Black Dragon
- Hidden Valley Capture: Destroying Monolith will be more difficult than before.
  Castle Siege: Defeating or destroying all monsters, Castle Gate, Castle Gate Controller, Monolith, Castle Siege Tower, and Catapult will be more difficult than before.
 Sanctuary: Destroying Sanctuary will be more difficult than before.
  Tower of Black Dragon: Defeating Giant Rock Fiend will be more difficult than before.

[b]■ Convenience[/b]
● Favorites feature will be added to Portal and Raid.
- Upon activation of the Favorites menu left of the Portal and Raid contents list, it will be fixed to the top of the list.

[b]■ Chat[/b]
● Level restriction on Chat to All will be changed. 
- Chat to all channels will be available after character Level 40.
- No changes applied to Party Chat, Clan Chat and that of Allied Clans.
 
● Notification colors will be separately displayed with the following category of Chats.
-Type/Notification Color
Clan : Green
Allied Clans : Blue
Party : Light Blue
Whisper : Pink

[b]■ Unseal[/b]
● Speed-Up All feature will be added upon unsealing.
- You can immediately finish all unsealings with Gold or Speed-Ups.

[b]■ Storage[/b]
● ‘Move All’ feature will be added to storage.
- Upon moving items to storage after activating the Move All, you do not need to set the quantities of item.

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Improvement to display the amount of increased EXP gain on the vigor notifications to the second decimal place.
2. Fix of the issue to prevent un-equipping Dragon Artifact and Mystical piece when using Class Change.
3. Improvements in the sorting of Enhancement Stone items in bag upon enhancing items.  
4. Fix of issue that cooperation missions can be completed in Domination Server.
5. Fix of issue of item information not being displayed from the 31st item when there are 31 or more items registered in the Favorites list in Market.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/a7e589ef36b41e20217bb1534946636a9c1cf5d3.png[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Thursday, January 26th, 2022.

=========================

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Field Area: Snowfield
- Go on your adventure with a new field area.
2. New Cooperation Mission: Stage 10
- Defeat mighty bosses with clan members and get rewards.
3. New Event: Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event
- Challenge yourself to obtain Legendary Magic Stone.
4. Adjustments to crafting costs and prices in NPC Shop.
- Crafting cost for Dragon Artifact will be adjusted.
- Price for Ice Crystal will be adjusted upon purchasing the item.
5. Adjustments in costs and probability of Enchant.
- Probability of Special Enchant for Equipment will be adjusted.
- Enchant costs for Dragon Artifact will be adjusted. 
6. New Legendary Spirit: Small White Dragon Chunryu
- Summon and equip a spirit that supports both you and your party members.
7. New Mount: Season IV
- Get the fascinating mounts of MIR4.
8. Improvements to the ‘Sanctuary PvP Mechanisms’.
- You can directly attack enemies who attack the Sanctuary.

=========================

[h3][January 26th Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈
■ New Field Area — Snowfield
● ‘Snowfield’ will be newly opened, and the Max. level will be expanded to 180.[/b]
- Nine Dragon Ice Field, Nine Dragon Ice Palace, Nine Dragon Labyrinth, Sagittarion Valley, Sagittarion Temple will be added in ‘Snowfield’, and with the addition of new field area, there will be a significant increase in the number of new available main quests, missions, and requests.
- Max advancement level for Conquest buildings will be expanded to stage 23 except for Sanctuary of Hydra. Upon advancing the Tower of Conquest to stage 23, your characters will be able to reach up to a Maximum of level 180.
- Max advancement stage of ‘Constitution’ will be increased to stage 19, and that of 'Inner Force' Muscle Strength Manual, Nine Yin Manual, and Nine Yang Manual will be increased to stage 18.
- 151 new codices will be added with the addition of new field areas.

[b]● Level Achievement reward will be added.[/b]
- Lv. 175 reached: Lv. 175 Reward Coffer x1, Legendary Blue Dragon Statue x1
- Lv. 180 reached: Lv. 180 Reward Coffer x1, Legendary Blue Dragon Statue x1

[b]■ Field Boss
● New field boss ‘Netherevil Celestial’ will be spawned in Nine Dragon Labyrinth 4F. [/b]
- Boss: Netherevil Celestial
- Level: 175
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/6a4091e23797df2b2e4a41846948244d3f566f62.png[/img]

[b]● New field boss ‘Wretched Blood General’ will be spawned in Sagittarion Valley 4F. [/b]
- Boss: Wretched Blood General
- Level: 180
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/9ab5cd10cf09d13ad65569a917b1ade179b6510a.png[/img]

[b]■ Expedition
● Expedition Available Area will be added.[/b]
- New Areas: Nine Dragon Labyrinth 4F, Sagittarion Valley 4F

[b]■ Clan
● Clan Cooperation Mission Stage 10 will be added.[/b]
- Boss: Azure Stone Golem General
- Level: 160
- Spawn Area: Nine Dragon Labyrinth 4F

[b]■ Event[/b]
[b]● Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event will be added.[/b]
1) Event Period
- January 30th, 2023, 00:00 (UTC+8)–February 1st, 2023, 23:59 (UTC+8)
2) Costs
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Type[/th]
        [th]1 Summon[/th]
        [th]10+1 Summons[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Magic Stone[/td]
        [td]100,000 Darksteel[/td]
        [td]1,000,000 Darksteel[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]※ 1 Free Summon will be provided every day.[/b]
3) Cautions
- You can participate in the event through the fire-cracker shaped icon at the top left of the in-game windows.
- The maximum limit for Event Summons per day is 110 Summons (10+1 Summon x10), and the total limit for the entire event period is 330 Summons. (1 Free Summon per day excluded)
- Daily Summon Count will be reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+8).
- Accumulated Event Incense Burner points will be deleted after the event period. (Event Incense Burner points only)
- Please be aware that all Event Incense Burner points accumulated from previous Legendary Magic Stone Challenge events will have been reset every time this event starts.
[b]※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1169][[Notice] Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event][/url] for further details.[/b]

[b]■ Craft[/b]
[b]● Crafting costs for Dragon Artifact will be adjusted.[/b]
- Epic Dragon Artifact: 1,000 Dragonsteel → 500 Dragonsteel
- Legendary Dragon Artifact: 20,000 Dragonsteel → 5,000 Dragonsteel

[b]■ NPC Shop
● Price of Rare Ice Crystal will be adjusted.[/b]
- NPC: [Spacetime Merchant] Lamper
- Location: Arcadia Spirit Village
- Price of Rare Ice Crystal: 100,000 Darksteel → 50,000 Darksteel

[b]■ Enchant
● Probability of Special Enchant for Equipment will be adjusted.[/b]
- You will now be able to get better properties when Enchanting Equipment.

[b]● Enchant costs for Dragon Artifact will be adjusted.[/b]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Grade[/th]
        [th]Required Item[/th]
        [th]Change in Required Quantity[/th]
        [th]Required Resources[/th]
        [th]Quantity[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Rare Dragon Artifact[/td]
        [td]Dragon Artifact Enchant Scroll[/td]
        [td]1 (No changes applied)[/td]
        [td]Dragonsteel
Darksteel[/td]
        [td]1 (No changes applied)
4,000 → 2,000[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Epic Dragon Artifact[/td]
        [td]Dragon Artifact Enchant Scroll[/td]
        [td]5 → 2[/td]
        [td]Dragonsteel
Darksteel[/td]
        [td]4 → 2
40,000 → 10,000[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Legendary Dragon Artifact[/td]
        [td]Dragon Artifact Enchant Scroll[/td]
        [td]20 → 5[/td]
        [td]Dragonsteel
Darksteel[/td]
        [td]20 → 5
200,000 → 100,000[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]■ Spirit
● New Legendary Aqua Spirit ‘Small White Dragon Chunryu’ will be added.[/b]
- Passive bonus once summoned: Spell DEF +40
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2621b24d8927ae2f43b20d7820d456a42aaeff8b.png[/img]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill[/th]
        [th]Skill Effect[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Pure White Porcelain[/td]
        [td]Increases Max HP by 2300, Max MP by 800, Bash ATK DMG Boost by 30%, and Bash DMG Reduction by 30%.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Blue Cobalt[/td]
        [td]Increases Monster ATK DMG Boost by 15%, Monster DMG Reduction by 15%, Silence RES Boost by 25%, and Knockdown RES Boost by 25%. [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Clear Enamel[/td]
        [td]Increases Hunting EXP Gain by 20%, Antidemon Power by 10%, and Item Drop Chance by 10%.
Hard and Smooth[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Hard and Smooth[/td]
        [td]Increases EVA by 300 and Crit EVA by 300 for 4 sec upon using Evade. Cooldown 25 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][Party Leader] Soul Jar[/td]
        [td]Increases the party's Skill ATK DMG Boost by 5%, Boss DMG Reduction by 20%, and Antidemon Power by 10% for 60 sec on attack. Cooldown 30 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
- Small White Dragon Chunryu's skill [Party Leader] Soul Jar effect will be indefinitely applied to the character that has this spirit summoned, and if this character is a party leader, party members located within 30m of the character's range will also receive the buffs.
- Small White Dragon Chunryu will only be obtained from Legendary Spirit Special Summon.

[b]● Spirit stone for Legendary Spirit ‘Small White Dragon Chunryu’ can be obtained through Legendary Spirit Special Summon.[/b]
- Period: After January 26th Update, 2023–Before February 21st Update, 2023

[b]● Legendary Spirits referred below will be obtainable from Spirit Summon, Combine, and Exchange.[/b]
- Legendary Spirits Being Added: Dark Crown Prince Wooska, North Sea Demon King Sumacheon, Alluring Spirit Cat Lulu

[b]■ Outfits and Mounts
● New mounts will be added.[/b]
- Cost: Mount Exchange Ticket Season Ⅳ
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/d337ada6e323c7864a9534257f11d9428223a81f.png[/img]
Evil Vanquisher Unicorn Ox
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/3384a9ce719e5cab4cd579c5a0f773df4ecc87ab.png[/img]
Twin Stream Temple Wooden Fish

[b]● Weapon Exchange Ticket: Season I will be added.[/b]
- Weapon Season I will be sold again for Dragonians who have not purchased them.

[b]■ PvP — Sanctuary
● Your PvP status will be immediately shifted to Hostile upon attacking the Sanctuary.[/b]
- The PvP status of any character that attacks the Sanctuary will immediately shift to Hostile, and will be open to attack by the character that has summoned the Sanctuary, and their clan members. 
- The alignment points of any character that has summoned the Sanctuary and their clan members will not decrease upon killing enemies who have attacked their Sanctuary.
- Characters currently in a Duel will not be able to attack enemies attacking the Sanctuary.

[b]■ Summon
● ‘Stop upon obtaining’ feature will be added to 100+10 Summons.[/b]
- Applied To: Epic Special Summon, Legendary Special Summon
- After choosing the option ‘Stop upon obtaining’ and proceeding with 100+10 Summons, the Summon will automatically stop upon obtaining the Target Spirit for Special Summon.

[b]■ Item
● The information button for Codex Gear and Demon Badge will be changed.[/b]
- [Craft] button in the information window of Codex Gear will be deleted.
- [Craft] button will be added to the information window of Demon Badge.

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Fix on the issue of displaying the Favorite tab of Chatting abnormally after Wayfarer Travel and logging in to the game with another device.
2. Fix on the issue of unprocessable Auto Air Walk upon proceeding with a specific quest.
3. Fix on the issue that only the one who has dealt a final strike on the quest monster within the party can clear the party quest.
4. Improvements to item use with an increase of the maximum amount of item boxes that can be used at once from 100 to 500.
5. Improvement in the display of names where, when a character attacks another character whose name has turned pink due to PK, the attacking character's name will also turn pink.

The update maintenance is over. 

However, the update maintenance on iOS platforms has been postponed due to the delay in iOS review of Apple Appstore.

Dragonians who are using ios platforms access the game through other platforms, and we will open the server immediately when the review has been confirmed. 

[Maintenance]

- ASIA / INMENA / EU / SA / NA

[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈
1. New Events: 2 Winter-themed Events
- Obtain various items with Snowflake 14-Day Check-in event.
- Winter Discount Event wil be conducted.
2. New Item type: ‘Tier II’.
- 'Tier II' Magic Stone/Spectrumite/Spirit Treasure will be added.

4. New Epic Spirit: Spring Messenger Yobi

※ Maintenance schedule may change depending on the circumstances without prior notice.

Thank you.

● You can enhance 'Tier II' items through Special Enhancement.[/b]
- It will be accessible through Menu → Forge → Special Enhancement tab.
- ‘Tier II’ items above Epic or higher grade can be enhanced.
- ‘Special Enhancement Stone’ items of the same grade as the item being enhanced will be consumed, as well as a certain amount of in-game resources.
- Upon using ‘Oil of Blessing’, Success Chance will be increased by 10%.
- Enhancement may result in Success, Failure, or Great Failure.
- Great Failure chance exists from Lv. 1, upon Great Failure, the equipment will be destroyed and you can obtain ‘Treasure Shard’ and material items.

- Summonable Location: ‘Summon II’ tab
- Unenchanted items will be obtained upon summoning, and ‘Tier II’ items will be certainly obtained after enchanting them as same as the previous Summon system.
- Divine Dragon’s Promise will be applied, and Epic items will be obtainable upon reaching Max 1000 points from the Promise system.
- Divine Dragon’s Promise point will be reset upon obtaining Epic items prior to reaching 1000 points.
 
[b]● Spirit Special Summon will be added.[/b]
- Spirit Stone for Epic Spirit ‘Spring Messenger Yobi’ can be obtained.
- Divine Dragon's Promise Points from the previous Special Summon will reset.
 
[b]■ Special Enchant
● Cost of Special Enchant for Legendary-graded equipments will be adjusted.[/b]
- Pre-change: Dragonsteel x10
- Post-change: Dragonsteel x5

4. Spirit/Skill Tome summon tabs moved from Summon I to Summon II.
5. Fixed issue regarding the in-game 'Portraits' event.
6. Improvements to the effect of Great HP Potion.

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4.[/b]

Greetings, this is MIR4. 

We have confirmed an issue with receiving the Repeat rewards over the daily Obtain limits regarding the in-game event 'Portrait' newly added on December 5th. Please be notified that the content will be temporally deactivated to fix the issue, and we will try to fix this issue promptly and re-open the event.

 ■ Period
 - December 5th, Monday, 2022, 19:55 (UTC+8) ~ until later announcement

 ■ Target
- All servers

We apologize for causing inconvenience to your gameplay, and we will do our best to provide a stabilized gaming environment.

Thank you.

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, November 29th, 2022.

==================================

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Event: Portrait
- Collect NPC’s portraits with clan members and exchange them with various items.
2. New Raid: ‘Vipergeist Prison’
3. New Boss Raid: ‘Claydoh GEN’
4. New Chamber: ‘Antidemon Chamber’
- In the Antidemon Chamber, the higher the character's Antidemon Power stat, the higher the damage dealt will be.
5. New 28-Day Attendance System: Lucky Cat Luckster’s Check-In
- You can obtain various item rewards throughout the new Attendance System.

==================================

[h3][November 29th Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-game Updates◈
■ Event
● New Event ‘Portrait’ will be added.[/b]
- This event is a Clan event rewarded by ranking based on accumulation points per clan obtained from collecting Portraits during the event period.
- The first event will begin on December 5th, 01:00 (based on regional server time), and will be conducted once every 4 weeks.
- Portrait collection will be available for 1 week, and portraits will be dropped by field monsters.
- Collection points will be accumulated per each claimed portrait collection reward, and these points will be added to the overall points of each Clan to be applied to the Portrait ranking.
- Clan members in the same clan can exchange their portraits with each other through Clan Exchange.
- A special buff that lasts for 3 weeks will be granted based on rankings calculated when the collection period ends.
[b]※ Please refer to [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1117]Notice - New in-game Event ‘Portrait’[/url]] for further details.[/b]
 
[b]■ Raid
● New Raid ‘Vipergeist Prison’ will be added.[/b]
- Monster Level: 165
- Required Power Score: 132,000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/0eb0c4b5fb941e5a52897db4662b79539c507cef.png[/img]

[b]■ Boss Raid
● New Boss Raid ‘Claydoh GEN’ will be added.[/b]
- Monster Level: 160
- Required Power Score: 130,000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/fa36272ee98c7df08d90d0e5ff09c95f62d23828.png[/img]
  
[b]■ Magic Square
● New Chamber ‘Antidemon Chamber’ will be added.[/b]
- You can enter Antidemon Chamber with a random chance at Magic Square 6F~8F.
- Upon defeating Unique monsters, a boss monster will be spawned with a random chance. 
- The higher the character's Antidemon Power stat, the higher the damage dealt will be.

[b]■ Attendance
● New 28-Day Attendance System ‘Lucky Cat Luckster’s Check-in’ will be added.[/b]
-Attendance system to obtain various summon tickets, entry tickets, and valuable material items through daily check-in.
- It will be available from December 1st, 00:30 (UTC+8).
[b]※ Please refer to [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/1113][Notice] New 28-Day Attendance system ‘Lucky Cat Luckster's Monthly Check-in’[/url]] for further details. [/b]

[b]■ Spirit
● Legendary Spirit Summon[/b]
- Spirit stone for Legendary Spirit ‘North Sea Demon King Sumacheon’ can be obtained through Legendary Spirit Summon.
- Event Period: After maintenance on November 29th–before maintenance on December 27th
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/e836257b2eb237818b3910383341656f1a0977cd.png[/img]

- Appearance Equipment:  Venomous Assault Saber / Venomous Assault Staff / Venomous Assualt Sword / Venomous Assualt Bow / Venomous Assualt Spear (Five types)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/dc5c8cf3efc851635186fe5fb0a547a4b5a6bf54.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, November 1st, 2022.

=========================

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
1. New Clan Challenge Stage: Stage 6
2. New Clan Expedition Boss: Sanguinary Serpent Scorpion
3. New Attendance Event: Bunny Guru Hoppy’s Check-in
- New 28-Day Attendance event ‘Monthly Attendance Event with Horyong’ will end and the new event ‘Bunny Guru Hoppy’s Monthly Check-in’ will take place.  

=========================

[h3][November 1st Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
[b]■ Clan Challenge
● Clan Challenge Stage 6 will be added.
● Details[/b]
- Boss: Enraged Nefariox King/Forsaken King/Deranged Hellbound Revenant/Heavenly Asura/Ghostly Bogey
- Time Limit: 30 minutes
- Cost: 15,000 Clan Funds

[b]● New Bosses[/b]
- Heavenly Asura
- Boss Level: 170
