notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/162763aafb17f92841ea2fd473b3dc636856b7dd.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4.[/h2]
Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, March 22nd, 2022.


[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[table]			[tr]			[td]				
[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]
	
[b]1. Class Balance Changes[/b]		
- In this balance patch, we focused on listening to the voices of Dragonians coming through various MIR4 community channels to provide a more positive gameplay experience. Various balance changes associated with PvE and PvP aspects for most classes have been made through this patch.
							
[b]2. Divine Dragon's 7-Day Attendance Event[/b]
- New 7-Day Attendance Event will commence which will give character growth supplementary items and Divine Dragon's Blessing.
				
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
	
[h3][Mar. 22nd Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ Balance Changes[/b]
[b]● The following classes will be subject to balance skill changes through the upcoming maintenance update.[/b]

[b]<Warrior>[/b]
In order to complement the shortcomings of warriors who were unable to effectively function in their main role as a tank due to the lack of HP recovery means via skills during battles, we've improved several skill effects to account for increase in HP recovery and defensive stat boost upon skill use.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill Name[/th]
        [th]Changes[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Riposte[/td]
        [td]> [New] Recovers its health immediately after using the skill.
- Tier 8 : 10%
- Tier 10 : 20%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Iron Shackle[/td]
        [td]> Cooldown reduction 48 sec. → 40 sec.
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Berserk[/td]
        [td]> Removal of amplified DMG penalty received after using the skill.[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Barbaric Charge[/td]
        [td]> [New] Increases its own PHYS DEF and CRIT EVA when skill is used.
- Tier 8 : PHYS DEF +150 and CRIT EVA +100 for 6 sec
- Tier 10 : PHYS DEF +300 and CRIT EVA +200 for 6 sec[/td]
    [/tr]
 [tr]
        [td]Lion's Roar[/td]
        [td]> Minor DMG will be dealt to enemies on the outer edge of the skill's main area of effect.
- Maximum damage remains the same.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]<Sorcerer>[/b]
Sorcerers were lacking efficiency in combat due to their longer spellcast duration as well as majority of skills being non-targeted AoE spells limiting on-demand target specific damage during battles. Skill balance changes include increase in area of effect increase, increase in maximum number of enemies hit, and overall skill cooldown reduction.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill Name[/th]
        [th]Changes[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Thunderstorm[/td]
        [td]> Skill rework
Previous : Strikes enemies with thunderbolts created on random spots in the vicinity of the enemy 
Post-Change : Strikes an enemy with thunderbolts centered around the enemy's location. ( 3 hits + additional 1 hit in the center of the skill area of effect.)

> Maximum number of enemies hit.
- 8 → 10

> Adjustment on skill hit rate through the reduction of spellcasting time.
- Reduced the spellcasting time of the skill[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Chain Lightning[/td]
        [td]> Maximum number of enemies hit.
 - 6 → 7

> Increased damage inflicted to subsequent targets hit by Chain Lightning (2nd~6th hits)
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Flame Strike[/td]
        [td]> Cooldown reduction 50 sec. → 45 sec.[/td]
    [/tr]
  [tr]
        [td]Frozen Block[/td]
        [td]> The movement speed of the enemy will decrease when the Ice Shield gets created.
Previous : Frostbite (Decrease in movement speed) will be triggered to chilled enemies once Ice Shield breaks. 
Post-Change : Frostbite (Decrease in movement speed) will be triggered to chilled enemies as soon as the Ice Shield skill is casted.

> DMG inflicted to surrounding enemies upon skill cast increased and DMG inflicted to surrounding enemies at the end of the skill reduced. 
 - There will be no changes on its total DMG.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]<Taoist>[/b]
While Taoist is playing an essential role in party hunting, she is somewhat vulnerable in solo hunting. To supplement this shortcoming, we have decided to improve the skill range and the area of effect of some attack skills.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill Name[/th]
        [th]Changes[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Moonlight Orb[/td]
        [td]> Increase in Skill Range and Area of Effect[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Rain of Blades[/td]
        [td]> Increase in Skill Range[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Tai Chi[/td]
        [td]> Minor DMG will be dealt to enemies on the outer edge of the skill's main area of effect.
 - There will be no changes on its total DMG.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]<Lancer>[/b]
Lancer has been showing weakness in hunting monsters due to the small Skill AoE. In an effort to relieve this issue, we have increased the range and area of effect of certain skills.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Skill Name[/th]
        [th]Changes[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Sweeping Storm[/td]
        [td]> Minor DMG will be dealt to enemies on the outer edge of the skill's main area of effect.
 - There will be no changes on its total DMG.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Dragon Tail[/td]
        [td]> Minor DMG will be dealt to enemies on the outer edge of the skill's main area of effect.
 - There will be no changes on its total DMG.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[b]■Divine Dragon's 7-Day Attendance Event[/b]
[b]● Event Period : Mar. 22nd, 2022 (Scheduled Maintenance) ~ Apr. 11th, 2022 23:59 (UTC+8)[/b]
[b]● Character growth supplementary items and Divine Dragon's Blessing can be claimed through the 7-day attendance reward.[/b]
[b]● Additional Divine Dragon's Blessing can be purchased through the shop.[/b]
[table]			[tr]			[td][b]Day 1[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Day 2[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Day 3[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Day 4[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Day 5[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 6[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Day 7[/b]				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]3 Vigor Pills (60 Minutes)				
			[/td]			[td]2 Epic Prosperity Cordials				
			[/td]			[td]2 Secret Peak Tickets				
			[/td]			[td]2 Epic Greed Cordials				
			[/td]			[td]2 Magic Square Tickets				
			[/td]			[td]2 Epic Advancement Cordials				
			[/td]			[td]1 Divine Dragon's Blessing				
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
- Players can use 'Divine Dragon's Blessing' to receive one combination result item among Dragon Scale/Dragon Leather/Dragon Horn/Skill Tome/Spirit Stone. (Highest grade obtainable through the ticket is based on your highest Combination attempts.)
- You can access [Divine Dragon's Blessing] in the event menu.
[b]※ 7-Day Attendance rewards can be claimed until Apr. 5th (Tue), 23:59 (UTC+8).[/b]
[b]※ 'Divine Dragon's Blessing' acquired before this event can't be used and will be deleted.[/b]
[b]※ ‘Divine Dragon's Blessing’ can be used until Apr. 11th, 2022 23:59 (UTC+8), and it will be deleted after the scheduled period.[/b]

[b]■Market[/b]
[b]● 'Purchase History' will be added to the Market[/b]
- 'Purchase History' tab will be newly added to the Market menu.
- 'Settlement History' and 'Purchase History' will be stored for 30 days

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Fixed an issue with how the auto-attack reacted during the Clan Expedition: Infernal Abomination.

notes.title: Patch Note - Feb. 22nd, 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f3bba9728a5c62355fc1716f6be52b58b42793cc.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, February 22nd, 2022.

====================================================================
[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]1. 200th Day Celebration Event : Check-in Event[/b]

[b]2. NFT characters can now be imported and loaded from the character creation screen.[/b]

[b]3. The CAPTCHA verification system, 'Proving Eligibility', has been enhanced to improve the gaming environment and gameplay experience of all Dragonians.[/b]
    - Dragonians will be required to re-verify their eligibility once every 24 hours. (countdown timer
      will be prompted in game)
    - Those who do not re-verify their eligibility will automatically be disconnected from the game
      once the timer counts down to 0.

[b]4. Total duration of items registered for sale on the market will be significantly increased.[/b]
====================================================================

[h3][Feb. 22nd Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ 200th Day Celebration Event - Check-in Event[/b]
[b]   ● Event Period : Feb. 22nd, 2022 (scheduled maintenance) ~ Mar. 22nd, 2022 00;00 (UTC+8)
   ● 1st Check-in Event : Feb. 22nd, 2022 (scheduled maintenance) ~ Mar. 8th, 2022 00;00 (UTC+8)[/b]
[table]			[tr]			[td][b]Day 1[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 2[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 3[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 4[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 5[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 6[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 7[/b][/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]				2 Vigor Pills (30 Minutes)					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Speed-Up Tickets (60 Minutes)					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Epic Advancement Cordials					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Epic Prosperity Cordials					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Epic Greed Cordials					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Vigor Pills (60 Minutes)					
								[/td]			[td]				1 Epic Noirsoul Herb			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]● 2nd Check-in Event : Mar. 8th, 2022 (scheduled maintenance) ~ Mar. 22nd, 2022 00;00 (UTC+8)[/b]
[table]			[tr]			[td][b]Day 1[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 2[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 3[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 4[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 5[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 6[/b][/td]			[td][b]Day 7[/b][/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]				2 Vigor Pills (30 Minutes)					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Speed-Up Tickets (60 Minutes)					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Epic Advancement Cordials					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Epic Prosperity Cordials					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Epic Greed Cordials					
								[/td]			[td]				2 Vigor Pills (60 Minutes)					
								[/td]			[td]				1 Epic Noirsoul Herb			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]※ Players must manually claim their daily Check-in rewards from the event page each day.
※ Any unclaimed reward from the 1st Check-in Event will not be redeemable once the 2nd Check-in Event begins on Mar. 8th, 2022. 
※ Players can only claim the final reward of the event 'Epic Noirsoul Herb' after checking in all 7 days during the event period.[/b]

Please refer to [b][Event - 200th Day Celebration Check-in][/b] for more details.

[b]■ Divine Dragon's Blessing[/b]
[b]● Period : Feb. 22nd, 2022 (scheduled maintenance) ~ March 22nd 00;00(UTC+8)
● Players can buy a special ticket once per a character that can be used to receive a combination result item. (Highest grade obtainable through the ticket is based on your highest Combination attempts.)[/b]
- You can access [b][Divine Dragon's Blessing[/b]] in the event menu.
[b]※ ‘Divine Dragon's Blessing’ Ticket can be used until Mar. 21st, 2022 23;59;59 (UTC+8), and it will be deleted after the scheduled period. 
※  Dragon Claw and Dragon Eye are not included in the combination failure attempts.[/b]

Please refer to [b][Divine Dragon's Blessing][/b] for more details.

[b]■ Importing Character NFTs[/b]
[b]● 'Load NFT' function will be added to the Character Creation screen.[/b]
- Character NFTs can now be imported to a new server and be directly loaded from the Character Creation menu.
- The game account must first be linked to your WEMIX account in order to import Character NFTs. It will automatically prompt you with the linking process if it had not been already linked.
- Character NFT loading procedure has not been changed.

[b]■ Proving Eligibility[/b]
[b]● The CAPTCHA verification system, 'Proving Eligibility', has been enhanced to improve the gaming environment and gameplay experience of all Dragonians.[/b]
- After succeeding in 'Proving Eligibility' and logging in to the game, players will automatically be disconnected from the game after 24 hours since the initial verification.
- Remaining Time will be displayed through the timer and players can see the details from the pop-up screen by clicking the timer icon.
- An in-game reminder will be displayed 3 hours prior to the automatic disconnection. Additional reminders will be displayed every 1 hour until being disconnected.
- Players won't be able to enter Magic Square, Secret Peak, Raid, and Boss Raid from 30 minutes before the automatic disconnection, and the remaining time of the Portal contents can not be extended.
- Automatic disconnection Timer won't reset even after using Wayfarer Travel.
- Automatic disconnection Timer is bound to the account, shared by all of the characters on the account.

[b]■ Market[/b]
[b]● Sale Duration after registering in the market will extend from the initial 3-day period to a 14-day listing.[/b]

[b]■ Craft
● Removal of Event Craft Items[/b]

[b]● Removed items[/b]
- Epic Spirit Treasure Token Box
- Rare Spirit Treasure Token Box
- Uncommon Spirit Treasure Token Box

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Drop Chances of Shards and Crystals obtainable from Magic Square and Secret Peak have been decreased.
2. Difficulty level of the Redmoon Mountain Request [Martial Arts Master's Training Method] has been lowered. 
- Required 'Mark of the Master' 20 → 8
3. The required number of resources to craft Death Flower Jade Tag will be reduced.
- Post-Change : 7 each of Dragon Jade/Purple Jade/Fire Jade/Metal Jade
- After Change : 3 each of Dragon Jade/Purple Jade/Fire Jade/Metal Jade

[h3][Feb. 8th Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ New Boss[/b]
● [b]'<Demon Spider of Hell> Krukan[/b]' will now appear.
- 'Krukan' will appear at the 'Shackling Abaddon' accessible from Bicheon Valley 4F.
[b]※ Players may enter ‘Shackling Abaddon’ through the Portal located in Bicheon Valley 4F.[/b]
- Spawn Time : [b][u]Every Monday, 23:00[/u][/b]
[b]※ Spawns will be based on Regional Server Times.
     ASIA(UTC+8)/INDIA(UTC+6)/MENA(UTC+3)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)[/b]

[b]■ Summon[/b]
● New Dragon Materials, 'Dragon Eye' and 'Dragon Claw', can now be summoned through the 'Summon' tab available in the 'Shop' menu.

● Autostart function will be implemented to Raid and Boss Raid parties.
- By enabling this function, Raids and Boss Raids will start automatically once the party becomes full.

- A Summary mail will be sent to clan members once Clan War ends.

● Character NFTs will now be subject to a cool-down period each time they are unsealed.
- Character NFTs that have been unsealed will be subject to a 5-day cool-down period restricting unsealed Characters from being resealed or using Wayfarer Travel to change servers.
※ Cool-down Period: 5 days from the moment Character NFTs are unsealed.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/fe3df9a1a174499eef8c2caeae3e238eb1d5b5df.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4.[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, January 25th, 2022.


[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. Two new types of equipment (Secondary Weapon, Earrings) will be added.

2. New Conquest 'Sanctuary of HYDRA' will be added.

3. New area 'Sanctuary of HYDRA' will be added.

4. New ‘Sanctuary of HYDRA’ NPC Shops will be added.

5. New monster summoning item ‘Forsaken Badge’ will be added. 

6. New Epic Spirit 'Brutal Lionheart Koiga' will be added.

7. New ‘CAPTCHA Verification’ system will be implemented.


[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

1. A brand new HYDRA refining system, 'Refinery' will be added.


[h3][January 25th Patch Note Details][/h3]

	
[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ New Equipment[/b]
[b]● Two new types of equipment (Secondary Weapon, Earrings) will be added.[/b]
- Secondary Weapon (Class-specific) and Accessories (General) will be added.
- Secondary Weapon can be crafted in the Craft tab using a special crafting material known as ‘Dragon Claw’.
- Accessories can be crafted in the Craft tab using a special crafting material known as ‘Dragon Eye’.

[b]● Secondary Weapon[/b]

			[/td]			[td][b]Secondary Weapon[/b]				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Warrior

			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Sorcerer

			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Lancer

			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Arbalist				
			[/td]			[td]Quiver				
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]● Equipment menu will be changed to accommodate two additional equipment types[/b]
- Equipment slots will be increased by 2 (from 8 to 10)
- New equipment types will be displayed through the auto-equip pop-up
- Equipment Craft menu will be adjusted to include additional equipment types
- Forsaken Badge tab will be added to the 'Other Combination' menu

[b]● 6 new missions will be added for players to obtain ‘Dragon Claw’ & ‘Dragon Eye’ to craft new equipment.[/b]
[table]			[tr]			[td][b]No[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Mission Area[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Acquirable Materials[/b]				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]1[/td]			[td]Bicheon Valley 4F				
			[/td]			[td]Uncommon Dragon Eye				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]2[/td]			[td]Bicheon Valley 4F				
			[/td]			[td]Uncommon Dragon Claw				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]3[/td]			[td]Snake Valley 4F				
			[/td]			[td]Uncommon Dragon Eye				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]4[/td]			[td]Snake Valley 4F				
			[/td]			[td]Uncommon Dragon Claw				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]5[/td]			[td]Redmoon Valley 4F				
			[/td]			[td]Uncommon Dragon Eye				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]6[/td]			[td]Redmoon Valley 4F[/td]			[td]Uncommon Dragon Claw				
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]■ Sanctuary of HYDRA[/b]
[b]● New conquest 'Sanctuary of HYDRA' will be added.[/b]
- Septaria, key materials required to refine HYDRA, will be obtainable by unlocking and upgrading ‘Sanctuary of HYDRA’ conquest.
- The number of Septaria obtained through ‘Sanctuary of HYDRA’ will increase based on the achieved stage level of the conquest.
- Septaria can only be claimed once per day through the ‘Sanctuary of HYDRA’ and the daily Septaria reward will reset each day at 00:00 (UTC+8).
- Septaria must be claimed each day manually as unclaimed Septaria will no longer be available upon daily reset.

[b]■ Boss Summoning[/b]
- A new item ‘Forsaken Badge’ can be crafted and used to summon a new boss monster.
- ‘Forsaken Badge’ can be crafted using ‘Forsaken Shard’ and ‘Purified Soul Stone’.
- ‘Forsaken’s Shard’ can be obtained through drops by defeating monsters.
- ‘Purified Soul Stone’ can be obtained through unsealing Spirit Treasure Box, Enhancement Stone Box, Treasure Box, or through Treasure Chests that drop from summoned bosses.
- Each ‘Forsaken Badge’ has a designated summoning location which summons different boss monsters. Players can obtain ‘Dragon Claw’ and ‘Dragon Eye’ by defeating boss monsters.

[b]■ New Area and New NPC[/b]
[b]● New area 'Sanctuary of HYDRA' will be added where special monsters can be summoned.[/b]
- <Hydrakin> Tala : Lv.70
- <Hydrakin> Amara : Lv.85 
- <Hydrakin> Yuta : Lv.100 
- <Hydrakin> Tremata : Lv.130 
- <Hydrakin> Tiamata : Lv.160
[u][b]※ You can summon monsters by using Summon Badge.[/b][/u]

[b]● New ‘Sanctuary of HYDRA’ NPC Shop will be added to Arcadia Spirit Village.[/b]

			[/td]			[td][b]<Exchange Septaria> Sumacheon[/b]				
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]■ Craft[/b]
[b]● Spectrumite Box / Purified Soul Stone will become craftable.[/b]
[b][NPC and Craft Result][/b]
1. <Craft Ancient Dragon Token> Dark Stallion Grifforse
- Rare Ancient Dragon's Spectrumite Box

2. <Craft Lucky Potion Box> Lucky Cat Luckster
- Rare Purified Soul Stone Box

3. Blue Dragon Craftsman
- Rare Glittering Powder Box
- Epic Glittering Powder Box
- Rare Life Elixir Box
- Epic Life Elixir Box
- Rare Purified Soul Stone Box
- Epic Purified Soul Stone Box

[b]● Newly added Secondary Weapons/Earrings will become craftable.[/b]
[b]● Forsaken Badge will become craftable.[/b]

[b]■ New Spirits[/b]
[b]● Epic Forest-type Spirit 'Brutal Lionheart Koiga' will be added.[/b]
   Passive bonus once summoned : 20 PHYS ATK

[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2022/01/1bf4daaa735037abdc126fe4f063897d.png[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td][b]Skill Name[/b]				
			[/td]			[td][b]Skill Effect[/b]				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Natural Hunter				
			[/td]			[td]Monster ATK DMG Boosts by 12%, Monster DMG Reduction by 12%, and ALL DMG Reduction by 10%.				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Lessons of the Wild				
			[/td]			[td]Hunting EXP Gain increases by 15%, and Lucky Drop Chances by 10%. Energy Gathering Time accelerates by 10%.				
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Law of the Jungle				
			[/td]			[td]After defeating an enemy, CRIT increases by 2, PHYS ATK by 2, and Spell ATK by 2 for 30 sec (Maximum 50 stacks)				
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]■ CAPTCHA Verification System[/b]
[b]● CAPTCHA verification system will be implemented.[/b]
- Implementation Date : Jan. 25th, 2022 scheduled maintenance update
- Players must first be verified through CAPTCHA prior to logging into the game.
- If verification has failed 3 consecutive times, players must wait 30 minutes before retrying.

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Menu changes in accordance with the addition of HYDRA Refinery.
2. The NFT menu and access interface has been changed.
- Previous : Global Map → Transfer Character → NFT
- Post-change : Menu → XDRACO → NFT
3. Create/Seal NFT character menu has been changed.
4. Fixed an issue with the direction of character ‘Evade’ being inconsistent with player control during battle.
5. Description of the Bloodshade Nefariox Horn mystery has been changed.
6. Descriptions of the Wrapped Rare/Epic Darksteel Box have been changed. 
7. Number of Identification Scrolls obtained from different grades of Sealed Boxes have changed.
8. The chance of Sealed Boxes being upgraded to a higher-grade Sealed Box upon unsealing has been adjusted.

[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ HYDRA Refinery[/b]
[b]● HYDRA is a refined version of DRACO that can be produced by combining DRACOs and Septaria through the new ‘Refinery’ menu available with the scheduled maintenance update.[/b]
- HYDRA ‘Refinery’ system will become available in MIR4 under the [XDRACO] menu.
- HYDRA is refined using 20 DRACOs as the base material, along with the specified amount of DRACOs and Septaria required as the ‘Refining Fee’.
- The variable cost of the ‘Refining Fee’ calculated through the Metamorphic Stage will determine the number of Septaria and DRACOs required to refine 1 HYDRA. Metamorphic Stage will be updated each day at 00:00 UTC+8. ([b][url=https://mir4draco.com/hydra#:~:text=at%20Stage(n)-,Metamorphic%20Staging,-Metamorphic%20Staging%20is]Learn more about Metamorphic Staging here[/url][/b])
- There is no limit on the number of HYDRA that can be refined.
- Refined HYDRA CANNOT be converted back into DRACOs.
- Results for successfully refined HYDRA will be sent to the in-game mailbox.
[b]※ You can check out further details of HYDRA in [[url=https://mir4draco.com/hydra]Seoul Spooning 2022 Webpage[/url]].[/b]

notes.title: Patch Note - January 11th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/201f108c475270d49e32d7baf14451cd78afce79.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4.[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, January 11th, 2022.

[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. Clan Sanctuary will be added.

2. New Magic stone: Spectrumite will be added.

3. New Codex achievements will be added.

4. Three New Hotkeys will be added.

[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

1. A new Condition for sealing Character NFT will be added.


[h3][January 11th Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ Clan Sanctuary[/b]
● Clan Sanctuary will be added.
- Clan Sanctuary is a new feature that can be used within Hidden Valley or Labyrinth, granting buffs to all clan members who use the area.
- Only Clan members who have War permissions can purchase a 'Sanctuary Summon Badge' from the Clan Shop to summon the Sanctuary. (Clan tech ‘Attack Formation’ must be achieved to use this feature)
- There is only 1 designated place per each map to summon the Sanctuary, and only one Sanctuary can be made per each clan.
- The Sanctuary can be destroyed by other Clans, and will not be destroyed by Allied Clans.
- Sanctuary will be undestructable for the first 3 hours from summon, and will be automatically destroyed after 72 hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/4e90356d39244dfc0220824bd79e6cff6301254f.png[/img]

[b]■ Spectrumite[/b]
● New item - Spectrumite will be added.
- Spectrumite is a new kind of magic stone that has 1.5 times higher ability stats compared to magic stones of the same grade.
- An additional 7th Magic Stone slot will be added for Spectrumite items.
- Spectrumite will vary in 4 grades - Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary.
- There will be no fixed options, with a maximum of 6 random additional options.
- Exclusive slot for the Spectrumite will open after reaching Tower of Quintessence Lv.12.

[b]■ Changes in in-game Shop[/b]
● Sale of ‘Daily Package’ products will be discontinued.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/e4c2c6f9e76556232f21e85fa03711eda4432568.png[/img]

[b]■ New Codex[/b]
● 5 new types of Time-Limited Codex will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/5a652bdb9cd9bc4a83bbeb2ec399e336a5aca4a8.png[/img]
● Codex Period
- After the scheduled maintenance on January 11th ~ February 8th, 00:00 (UTC+8)

[b]■ New Hotkeys[/b]
● 3 New Hotkeys will be added.
- PK Mode Change
- ATK Players Only (ON/OFF)
- Dash
※ You can check the Hotkeys in System → PC System → Hotkey

[b]■ Target Icon System (Clan Mark)[/b]
● 'Target Icon' (Clan Mark) will be added in the PC/Steam version.
- Target Icon is a function applicable to individual players.
- You can click the player to place an icon above the character.
- Target icons can be shared with Clan members.

[b]■ Portal[/b]
● Magic Square & Secret Peak Improvements
- Time Limit pop-up screen will be improved.
- Auto-Extend Time Limit feature will be added.
- The term 'Entry Ticket' will be changed into 'Entries'.
- An alert message will appear when you try to use an excessive amount of entry tickets at once.
- The location of the Time Limit Extension button[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2022/01/ab27c5d282d30fb88c795dcfe198677f.png[/img] and the Tooltip button[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2022/01/0a17611ba8935d1b42a5c0f2ff7ff35e.png[/img]will be switched.

[b]■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
1. Maximum number of Favorite items in the market will be increased from 30 to 60.
2. Fixed an issue of a monster being spawned in the safe zone right next to the portal in Redmoon Valley's 1st floor.
3. Added a feature to arrange the order of clan members in the Clan tab within a party.
4. Fixed an issue of not being able to use skills in certain situations.
5. Improved the feature of Territory titles.

[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

[b]■ New NFT Sealing condition[/b]
● New NFT Sealing condition:  Alignment Points
- Only characters that have 0 Alignment points or above can be sealed into NFT.

[b]● Characters that already have been sealed[/b]
- If the character's alignment point is above 0 : Alignment Point will remain after unsealing.
- If the character's alignment point is below 0 : Alignment Point will reset after unsealing.

notes.title: Patch Note - December 21st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/201f108c475270d49e32d7baf14451cd78afce79.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4.[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, December 21st, 2021.


[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

1. NFT website will open for Character Trades.

2. Collectible XDRACO items will be added.


[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. Darksteel Shop will be added in the In-game shop category.

2. Conquest: Training Sanctum’s Promotion requirements will be lowered.

3. The period of Divine Dragon’s Descending Event NPC will be extended.

4. [Nearby Character] option of the party invitation UI will be temporarily disabled.



[h3][December 21st Patch Note Details][/h3]


[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

[b][u]■ NFT Website Launch[/u][/b]
[b]● NFT Website will open to enable Character Trade.[/b]
- NFT is a new system that enables users to trade their characters in NFT through Wemix Wallet.
- The character must be Created into NFT and Sealed to be eligible for trades.
- Gold is needed to create and seal characters into NFT, and transaction fees will incur through Wemix Wallet.
- Sealed NFT characters will be excluded from the Character Selection menu and become unplayable.
- Sealed/Purchased NFT characters can be checked by clicking the 'Load NFT' icon on the bottom of the character selection menu or through the linked Wemix Wallet.
- Character's Gold will be bound to the account when the character is sealed.
- Server-based Codex achievements will be bound to the sealed character.

[b]● In-Game NFT Creation : [/b]
- Global Map > Click 'Move Character' on the bottom right corner > Select 'NFT Character'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/31faecabf867e9c06cf28f76530b8aa1370a6c32.png[/img]

- Menu > Transfer > Click 'NFT'
[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/12/1aa18fcd3c13028bafa9e2388b56488b.jpg[/img]


[b]<Seller>[/b]

[b]● Requirements[/b]
- Must be linked with 1 or more of Google, Apple, Facebook accounts
- Must be linked with Wemix Wallet account

[b]● Cost[/b]
- NFT Creation : 4,000 Gold
- NFT Sealing : 1,000 Gold

[b]● The character can be traded after Creation and Sealing is all completed.[/b]


<Buyer>

[b]● Requirements[/b]
- Must be linked with 1 or more of Google, Apple, Facebook accounts
- Must be linked with Wemix Wallet account

[b]● Purchased NFT character can be checked from the Character Selection menu.[/b]

[b][u]※ Refer to [[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/527]Game Encyclopedia - Character NFT[/url]] for more details about requirements and precautions.[/u][/b]

[u]■[/u][b][u] XDRACO Collectibles[/u][/b]
[b]● XDRACO items of Collectible property are marked with a 'Limited' tag.[/b]
[b]● 3 unique features of Collectible XDRACO items[/b]
- ‘Limited’ Tag : Displays Acquired order / Total Number
- Increased Safe enhancement level : Can be enhanced safely until +6
- Cannot be sold for copper in game


[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b][u]■[/u][/b][u][b] Darksteel Shop[/b][/u]
[b]● Darksteel Shop will be added in the In-game shop category.[/b]
- Various items including Summon Tickets and Enhancement stones can be purchased in the shop.

[u][b]■[/b][b] Conquest[/b][/u]
[b]● Promotion requirements for Training Sanctum's Stage 17 will be lowered.[/b]
- Muscle Strength Manual to Tier 12 > Tier 11
- Nine Yin Manual to Tier 12 > Tier 11
- Nine Yang Manual to Tier 12 > Tier 11

[u][b]■[/b][b] Event - Divine Dragon's Descending[/b][/u]
[b]● Deleted Event NPC <Joyful> Happiness will be replaced.[/b]
- Period : December 20th, 23:59 ~ December 27th, 23:59 (UTC+8)
[b][u]※ Deleted 'Dragon Fruit' event items will be replaced after the scheduled maintenance.[/u][/b]
     [b][u]Replaced 'Dragon Fruit' items can be exchanged through NPC Happiness until December 27th, 23:59. [/u][/b]

	
[u][b]■[/b][b] Party[/b][/u]
[b]● [Nearby Character] option in the Party Invite screen will be temporarily removed.[/b]

[u][b]■[/b][b] In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b][/u]
1. Fixed an issue of texts not being displayed in Epic Enhancement Stone Treasure Chest’s Source
2. Changed the location of Server Latency option in System → Game → Convenience tab
3. Fixed an issue of item broadcasts not showing up on obtaining Mystical Piece items above epic grade from Boss Drop Box.

● Phantasia regions: Phantasia Desert, Ant Hole, Sabuk Province, Sabuk Castle Underground Jail, Desert Road, Phantasia Labyrinth 
- New Main Quests, Mission and Requests added

● Maximum level expansion to Lv 130
- Maximum Conquest levels will be expanded to Stage 17. To level up to Lv 130, the Tower of Conquest must be promoted to Stage 17.
- Maximum tier for constitution and inner force will be expanded to 13 and 12. 
(Muscle Strength Manual/Nine Yin Manual/Nine Yang Manual)

2. New Raid - Crimson Dragon Nest

[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/12/20f2e6d9fe75744cd377141707770acf.png[/img]

- Event Period : December 14th ~ Before January 11th Update
- You can earn various items through 14 days of Attendance.
※ Event rewards can be claimed by clicking the Firecracker icon on the top left corner of the screen.

● Second Event : Yiun's Letter of Wishes
- Event Period : December 28th 00:00 ~ January 10th 24:00 (UTC+8)

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]


1. New System - 'Wayfarer Travel'

■ 'Wayfarer’s Pass' is a new item which will be added to enable players to transfer between Servers, Worlds, and Continents.

■ Requirements for 'Wayfarer Travel'
- Level 40+ Characters can travel to other Servers, Worlds, and Continents by using 'Wayfarer’s Passes'.
- Destination Server, World, or Continent can be selected through the Wayfarer Travel menu.
- All requirements listed on the Wayfarer Travel checklist must first be met.
- Players must wait 5 days after transferring their character to their destination server in order to use Wayfarer Travel again.

■ Number of Wayfarer’s Passes required for Wayfarer Travel
- Traveling within the same World: 1x Pass (ex. From ASIA 11 to ASIA 14, within ASIA1)
- Traveling to a different World of the same Continent : 2x Passes (ex. From ASIA 1 to ASIA 2)
- Traveling to a different Continent : 3x Passes (ex. From EU to ASIA)
※ Wayfarer’s Pass can be purchased from Shop with Gold.
※ For more details, refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/473][Game Encyclopedia - Wayfarer Travel][/url]


2. 100th Day Anniversary Event - ‘Divine Dragon Descending’

■ Event 1 : The Joy of Growth
- You can earn ‘Divine Dragon's Blessing’ and various items through 14 days of Attendance.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/446][Event - The Joy of Growth][/url] for more details.

■ Event 2 : Divine Dragon's Blessing
- Players can obtain a special ticket that can be used to receive a free combination result item. (Highest grade obtainable through the ticket is based on your highest Combination attempts.)
- You can access [Divine Dragon's Blessing] in the event menu.
※ ‘Divine Dragon's Blessing’ Ticket can be used until December 20th 23:59 (UTC+8), and it will be deleted after the scheduled period.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/447][Event - Divine Dragon's Blessing][/url] for more details.

■ Event 3 : The Joy of Gathering
- Event Period : November 30th(Tue) ~ December 14th(Tue) until scheduled maintenance update
- Details : Items obtained through hunting or Shop purchases can be exchanged for various reward items from Event NPC located in major cities.
※ Please refer to [url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/448][Event - The Joy of Gathering][/url] for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/1c587c7bb4bb5d97492672a0f8439e802bc43474.png[/img]

- Event Period : Surprise rewards will be sent to in-game mailboxes on [b][u]December 3rd (Fri)[/u][/b].
- Schedule : [b][u]9:00, 12:00, 19:00 (UTC+8)[/u][/b]
2) Surprise UP & DOWN
- Event Period : [b][u]November 30th (Tue) ~ December 14th (Tue)[/u][/b] until scheduled maintenance update
- Copper summons in the Shop will only cost 100 copper for the duration of the Event period.
- Gold summons will yield double mileage points for the duration of the Event period.

3. Horyong’s Monthly Attendance Event
- New Attendance Event will start from December 1st (Wed).
※ Current 28-Day Attendance Rewards can be claimed until the scheduled maintenance update on November 30th (Tue)
※ Current 28-Day Attendance Rewards will be removed after the scheduled maintenance update on November 30th (Tue)

■ Starting Date : [u][b]December 1st 00:00(UTC+8)[/b][/u]

■ New 28-Day Attendance Reward Details
- Players will be able to claim free daily rewards through attendance. Players may also choose to purchase two additional reward tracks to claim additional reward items, similar to Sarmati's Mission Scroll.
- Horyong's Rare Cintamani Stone and Horyong's Epic Cintamani Stone are two additional reward tracks that can be purchased to claim additional rewards. (These product purchases cannot be canceled or refunded)
- When the 28-Day Attendance Rewards have fully been claimed and once the 28-Day Attendance rewards reset, players must re-purchase the two additional reward tracks in order to claim additional reward items.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/d7c6904a9a85071d5ce7accf213869c51b614d12.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4. 
Update maintenance will proceed. 
Please disconnect from the game at a safe place before the maintenance.

 [Maintenance] 

■ Maintenance Schedule 
ASIA (UTC +8): Tuesday, November 30, 2021, 1:00 am~ 9:00 am
INDIA (UTC +6): Tuesday, November 29, 2021, 11:00 am~ November 30th 7:00 am
MENA (UTC +3): Monday, November 29, 2021, 08:00 pm~ November 30th 4:00 am
EU (UTC +2): Monday, November 29, 2021, 7:00 pm~ November 30th, 3:00 am
SA (UTC -3): Monday, November 29, 2021, 2:00 pm~ 10:00 pm
NA (UTC -4): Monday, November 29, 2021, 1:00 pm~ 9:00 pm

■ Maintenance Target 
- ASIA / INDIA / MENA / EU / SA / NA

[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈

1. 'Wayfarer Travel' will be added.
- Wayfarer Travel is a new system that enables players to transfer their characters between Servers, Worlds, and Continents.
2. 100th Day Anniversary Event - ‘Divine Dragon Descending’ will begin.
3. “Horyong’s Monthly Attendance Event” will begin.
4. New Mission Scroll 'Master: The Gathering' will be added.
- This new mission scroll will boost your character’s Gathering, Mining, and Meditation.
5. 2 new spirits will be added.
6. All Guest Account game access will be restricted.
- Guest Accounts must first be linked with a Social Network account in order to regain access to the game.

◈DRACO Updates◈

1. EXCHANGE BY DRACO(EXD) service will become live through exd.xdraco.com 
※ Portal / Raids will be restricted from 30 minutes before the maintenance. 
※ Maintenance can be extended or end early depending on the progress. 
※ You can't access the game during maintenance. 
※ We will open the servers in order. 

We will do our best to provide stable service. 

Thank you.

notes.title: 1st Restriction on Unsealing Box abusing accounts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/da11cfda094d90d2de29564fce83655be0be78ab.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4.[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

An Issue that was received through our customer center regarding the unsealing of the sealed box has been confirmed to be an internal system bug.

Therefore, we have proceeded with complete enumeration on this issue and permanently banned players who had abused this bug following our Management Policy ([url=https://cs.mir4global.com/policy/operation#:~:text=Article%2010%20Game%20use%20restriction%20standard]Management Policy Article 10, Clause 6[/url]).

As we strongly value the importance of providing and sustaining a Fair Gaming Environment for all players, we will strongly counter those nonacceptable acts that would harm this principle.

notes.title: Quest Rewards Adjustment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/02b8ea48eb4f74d4279c70f2746b20d95062ce5c.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4 [/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We have unveiled several new contents, systems, and features in the latest maintenance update. 

Among these new additions was the introduction of ‘Mystical Piece’- a brand new supplementary growth system, designed to increase character stats through the use of unique equipable items. 

New quests and rewards were added in accordance with the introduction of this new system. Unfortunately, we have found a critical issue with certain game data changes that were unintentionally applied to existing Hidden Valley quests and its rewards. Through this issue, players were able to obtain an excessive amount of reward items which was negatively affecting the overall game balance.  

As we strongly value the importance of providing and sustaining a Fair Gaming Environment for all players, we have decided to perform an urgent server maintenance to resolve this matter through correctional quest rewards adjustment.  

Through this quest reward adjustment, we will revert the number of quest rewards obtained post-patch back to its original state. Any items resulting from combination or crafting through the use of these quest rewards will also be removed and reverted back to its original state. Several quests and their rewards data will also be rebalanced to reflect upon their initially intended functionality.  

In order to implement such important changes rapidly and to maintain our Fair Gaming Environment, we decided to perform an urgent server maintenance. As such, we will be providing all players with one of each Portal & Raid content entry tickets through the in-game mailbox.  

We thank you for your cooperation and patience while we resolve this issue. 

Thank You.

notes.title: Patch Note - November 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/cccd3f53e79bffacb9e82ac7ec44df655f0603f4.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, November 16th, 2021.


[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. New content 'Castle Siege' will be added.
2.'Zoetrope' system will be added.
3. 'Mystical Piece' system will be added.
- Mystical Piece is a new system used to further develop your character’s growth.
4. Duel Arena will be added in Bicheon Castle.
5. Changes on Gathering/Mining/Crafting Darksteel

[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]
1. XDRACO Sealed Box will be added.


[h3][November 16th Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. New content - 'Bicheon Castle Siege'
■ ‘Bicheon Castle Siege’ will be added.
- To participate in the Bicheon Castle Siege, your clan is required to research level 1 'Defense Formation' under the Clan Warfare subsection in Clan Tech. Once your clan completes the necessary requirement to participate in Bicheon Castle Siege, Clan Funds can be used to bid in the Bicheon Castle Siege Tender.
- Clan with the highest Tender bid will be designated as the defender during Bicheon Castle Siege, and the clan with the second-highest Tender bid will be the designated besieging clan.
- Bicheon Castle Siege will be held once every 4 weeks on Sunday, 22:00 to 23:00 (1 Hour) server time.
- Each of the defending and besieging clans can have up to 150 members (300 members in total) participate in the Bicheon Castle Siege.
- Siege Weapon Craftsman (NPC) on both the defending and besieging clans’ territory can summon special Siege Weapons through the use of Clan Funds.
- Defending and besieging clans will engage in a fierce battle for up to 60 minutes. The defending clan must protect the monolith from being destroyed for 60 minutes, while the besieging clan will be required to penetrate the defending forces and destroy the monolith before the time runs out.

■ Siege Eve
- 'Castle Siege Eve' will be held from Monday to Saturday of the week that the Siege Tender is being held.
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be obtained and used to cheer for the clans that are participating in the Bicheon Castle Siege.
- 'Kingdom Coffer' can be exchanged by collecting and using 'Drums of Victory’.
- Maximum of 60 Kingdom Coffers can be acquired per character during the event period.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' can be registered in the time-limited codex after acquiring the item.

2. Zoetrope
■ Horse Emblem will be added.
- Horse Emblem can be obtained per advertisement videos watched and you can watch maximum of 20 Ads per day.
- Horse Emblems can be acquired by each character but are character-bound.
- The balance can be seen in the upper side of the shop tab.
- Token obtained by zoetrope views could be used to buy materials from Zoetrope exchange station.

■ Watching Ads
- 'Zoetrope View Rewards' can also be earned by watching 10 advertisements per day other than 'Horse Emblem'.
- Rewards can only be obtained by clicking the 'View Rewards' icon located in the upper right corner which will disappear after the reset on 00:00
※ Reset time will be based on Regional Server Times. 
    ASIA(UTC+8)/INDIA(UTC+6)/MENA(UTC+3)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
- 'Uncommon Zoetrope View Rewards' can be obtained by using Zoetrope View Rewards.
- Additional Zoetrope View Rewards with Rare, Epic grade can be obtained as an achievement by stacking the View Count.

- Duel Arena will be added in Bicheon Castle.
- The Duel Arena is located on the bottom of the Bicheon Castle map.
- Users will be able to view duels from the audience stand.

- If a character dies in the Arena, it will immediately recover and revive with full HP.

5. Changes on Gathering/Mining/Crafting Darksteel
- It will be more difficult to interrupt someone who is already gathering/mining.
※ Resistance on CCs such as Knockdown/Stun will increase, and mining won't be canceled unless CC’d.
- You will not be able to mine Darksteel if you have an internal injury.
※ Internal injury stacks up when you die and the stacks vary depending on the PK Alignment of your character.
※ There are 3 levels of internal injuries, Minor Injury/Major Injury/CRIT injury and you won't be able to mine Darksteel if you have a CRIT injury. 
※ You will get a CRIT injury if you have 20 stacks of internal injury.
- Mining amount will decrease on negative PVP status (Bad, Evil, Outlaw).
- Smelting or exchanging DRACO, or crafting a Darksteel box will be restricted if a character has less than 500k Darksteel.

6. In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements
- Translation feature will also be added in the Mail > Account tab.
- Chat copying feature will be added.
- Duration period will be displayed on buff items instead of Cool time.

- The sealed item won't be usable in the game after it’s been moved to XDRACO Warehouse, except for trading through the XDRACO market. (Can be reused after unsealing)
※ DRACO market will be added in future updates.

notes.title: Patch Note - November 2nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/19d8a39e1a5b52bf21cd9dd8e813ab75e5b1c02b.jpg[/img]

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, November 2nd, 2021.


[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

1. New Class[u] [b]'Arbalist'[/b][/u] will be added.
- Arbalist’s exclusive equipment will be added.

2. New system [u][b]'Class Change'[/b][/u] will be added.
- Class Change is a new feature enabling players to change into a different class while maintaining the character’s growth progression and achievements.

3. New content [b][u]'Solitude Training'[/u][/b] will be added.

4. Special boss [u][b]'Crimson Emperor Utukan'[/b][/u] will be added.


[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

1. Items with [u][b]XDRACO[/b][/u] property will be added.


[h3][November 2nd Patch Note Details][/h3]

[b]◈In-Game Updates◈[/b]

[b]1. New Class - Arbalist[/b]
- New class Arbalist will be added.
   Arbalist is the only ranged physical damage class in MIR4, an agile, battle-hardened assassin 
   delivering devastating blows to opponents from afar.

- 2 types of Arbalist codex will be added.
1. Codex Name : Dead Shot
    Item : Magical Arrowhead
2. Codex Name : Ultimate Blow
    Item : Deadly Arrowhead

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/70e126207f750780dbf5612231cd7e9ab38cfc69.png[/img]

[b]2. Class Change[/b]
- Class Change system enables you to switch between different classes while maintaining the original character's Level, Constitution, Inner force, and server-based codex.
- The Class Change system is available from Level 50, and different class types can be unlocked using copper and gold.
- All growth progression stats and inventory items will remain even when switching classes. However, class-specific skills will not be carried over and equipment will become unusable.

Further details can be checked in our Game Encyclopedia - '[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/316]Class Change[/url]'

[b]3. Solitude Training[/b]
- Solitude Training is a feature where players can further elevate their character’s efficiency in PvE and PvP environments through 4 specialized groups of vessel training. (Conception, Governing, Thoroughfare, Girdle Vessels)
- Solitude Training is available from Level 70.
- Each type of vessel training group is made up of 8 ability slots which enhance specific character stats. There are 32 types of stats in total, which can be enhanced up to rank 10 by using energy and resources.
- Source to gain required items for Solitude Training
   Snow Panax and Oil(Uncommon to Epic) can be obtained from Magic Square/Secret Peak 4th floor 
   and above.
   Snow Panax/Oil can drop from field monsters.
   Rare Noirsoul Herb can drop from Field/Elite/Labyrinth/Hidden Valley area types.
- Additional stats can be gained by reaching higher levels of enhancement.
- Solitude Training consists of 3 types of possible outcomes; Success, Fail, and Tangled Inner Force. Each time you are affected by the Tangled Inner Force, Enhancement levels can decrease by up to 3 ranks. 

Further details can be checked in our Game Encyclopedia - ‘[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/319]Solitude Training[/url]’.

[b]4. Special boss 'Crimson Emperor Utukan'[/b]
- Crimson Emperor Utukan: Lv. 130
- Utukan is approximately 10 times stronger than Snake Valley's 4th floor boss.
- Utukan’s lair can be found in the ‘Crimson Abaddon’ located on the 4th floor of the Snake Hidden Valley.
- Spawn Time : [u][b]Every Friday 22:00[/b][/u]
[b]※ Spawns will be based on Regional Server Times.
    ASIA(UTC+8)/INDIA(UTC+6)/MENA(UTC+3)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)[/b]

[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/10/884cf4fd479f687e4f24c2b7c26195b2.png[/img]

[b]5. Valley Proclamation[/b]
'Valley Proclamation' is a new feature allowing Hidden Valley owners to set up various notices or warnings for all Hidden Valley visitors to view.
- The leader and elders of the clan that owns Hidden Valleys can register the proclamation through the Territory menu.
- Proclamation menu also offers translation functionality for everyone to understand the message written by the Hidden Valley owners.
- The proclamation will be prompted as a pop-up message to all players that enter the Hidden Valley regardless of floors.

[b]6. New NPC Shop 'Lucky Cat Luckster'[/b]
- Lucky Cat Luckster is an NPC in Arcadia Spirit Village, where players can craft <Lucky Potion Box>.
- From Lucky Cat Luckster, higher tiered items can be obtained through ‘Great Success’.

[b]7. Guest Account Creation Removal[/b]
- Guest account creation option will be removed in this update.
※ Guest accounts created before the update will remain accessible post-update.
※ We recommend linking your game account using your social account(s) for a safe and stable gameplay experience.

[b]8. In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements[/b]
- Message display regarding Mail deletion date will be improved.
- Typo in Beastly Nefariox Talisman information will be fixed.


[b]◈DRACO Updates◈[/b]

[b]1. XDRACO items[/b]
- Items with XDRACO property will be added.
   Epic & Legendary Equipments (Weapon/Armor/Accessory)
   Epic & Legendary Magic Stones (7 types, Including Magic Stone of Growth)
   Epic & Legendary Spirit Treasures (Can only be obtained through Combining)
   XDRACO Chest (Glittering Powder, Life Elixir, Identification Scroll, etc)

- XDRACO items will be moved to your in-game XDRACO stash once sealed, which can then be traded on the XDRACO market.
   Items moved to XDRACO stash after sealing, won't be usable in the game. In order to use the item, it first needs to be unsealed and moved back into your inventory.

※ Trading features of XDRACO items through the XDRACO market will be added in future updates.

[h2]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/h2]

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, October 19th, 2021.


[h3][Main Updates][/h3]

1. 'Clan Challenge' content will be added.
In [b]Clan Challenge[/b], clan members will face against 5 boss monsters in consecutive order to defeat them within 30 minutes.
Clan members will be rewarded individual rewards for defeating each boss monster and stage level completion rewards for defeating all 5 boss monsters within 30 minutes.
[b][Time Period][/b]
[u][b]Every Sunday 00:00 ~ 23:59[/b][/u]
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times.
     ASIA(UTC+8)/INDIA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)

2. Change in Hidden Valley entry requirements

3. New Spirit - [Flame Hellborn Biyoho] 


[h3][October 19th Patch Note details][/h3]

[b]1. Clan Challenge[/b]
Clan Challenge is a new content where players can choose from 4 stage levels to defeat 5 boss monsters in a set order within 30 minutes.
- Content can be seen from Clan > Clan Info > Expedition tab.
- Clan Challenge becomes available by reaching level 3 in Expedition Technique of Clan Tech and each subsequent stage levels will be opened at levels 5/7/8 of Expedition Technique.
- Completion rewards for defeating each boss monster will be sent to the mailbox and the Clan Challenge will end once all 5 summoned boss monsters have been defeated.
- Maximum of 50 players can join, and all of the bosses will have to be defeated within 30 minutes to succeed in the challenge.

[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/290][Check out for more information in our Game Encyclopedia][/url]

Time Period : Every Sunday 00:00 ~ 11:59 pm
[b][u]※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times.[/u]
   [u] ASIA(UTC+8)/INDIA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)[/u][/b]

[b]2. Improvement in Clan features[/b]
- Clan leader or elders with the 'Finance' role of a clan occupying one of the Hidden Valleys will be able to distribute Darksteel stored in the Hidden Valley and Bicheon Castle territory storage directly to individual users.
- Clan Gold Donation will be changed to be accessible to users above level 40.

[b]3. New Spirit[/b]
New Spirit 'Flame Hellborn Biyoho' will be added.
- Type : Fire Spirit
- Summon Effect : 20 PHYS DEF

Skill
- [Shadow of Nightmare] Increases 300 MP, 100 CRIT, 20% CRIT ATK DMG.
- [Bewitchment] Increases 15% Hunting EXP, 15% Item Drop Rate and reduces Skill MP Cost by 5%
- [Burning Kiss] 10% chance to deal 100% of PHYS ATK and 100% of Spell ATK as damage to nearby enemies. (Cooldown 25 sec)

[img]https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/10/8d9c87d5bbacc2ee84cdd82265418b40.png[/img]

[b]4. Product Change on Steam[/b]
Some of the products will be discontinued in the Steam version.
7 products will be added in the Steam version.
- Special Summon: Dragon's Scale/Dragon's Leather/Dragon's Horn/Spirit Stone/Skill Tome
- Ancient Coin Package III, Ancient Coin Package IV

[b]5. Hidden Valley Requirement Changes[/b]
Hidden Valley access requirements will be modified to provide a better gaming environment.

[url=https://forum.mir4global.com/post/284][Go to Announcement][/url]

- A new Auto-Enchant system will be available to users over level 40.

notes.title: Update Preview - September 2nd, 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/de9430626ca03685fda88a6394fc61753ea18758.jpg[/img]

[b]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4[/b]

Greetings Dragonians,

First of all, we would like to thank all Dragonians for your passion and love for MIR4.

It has now been 6 days since our official launch and we want to share a preview of our very first update.

This update is currently scheduled for September 2nd, 2021. With this update, we want to address the issues we've been gathering from the community feedback as the most urgent fixes.

Besides the mentioned below, we will share the detailed patch notes through another announcement. 

- Fix MP Potion (Large) effects
- Fix DRACO DERBY calculation error
- UI improvements for various languages
- Fix unresponsive game launcher after reaching 100% installation (PC version)
- Fix game bugs

We will continue to monitor and gather feedback from our Dragonians through the MIR4 Discord, Facebook, and Customer Support Center about game improvement suggestions, bug reports, hacker reports, and more to ensure we continue to provide a fun game service. Please join the MIR4 official Discord and Facebook if you haven't already.

Discord - https://discord.gg/c3TxjUtyRG
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mir4global

Thank you!
